## 10. Metaplasticity: Plasticity of Plasticity

### BCM Theory

**Bienenstock, Cooper, Munro (1982)**

```
Plasticity Direction
        ↑
   LTP  │        ╱
        │      ╱
────────┼────╱────────── Activity Level
        │  ╱    θm (modification threshold)
   LTD  │╱
        ↓

θm slides based on history:
├── High prior activity → θm shifts right (harder to get LTP)
├── Low prior activity → θm shifts left (easier to get LTP)
└── Maintains homeostasis
```

### Molecular Mechanisms

```
SLIDING THRESHOLD MECHANISMS:

Prior high activity:
├── ↑ GluN2A/GluN2B ratio
├── ↓ LTP magnitude
└── ↑ LTD magnitude

Prior low activity:
├── ↓ GluN2A/GluN2B ratio  
├── ↑ LTP magnitude
└── ↓ LTD magnitude

Also involves:
├── Arc expression (scales AMPA receptors)
├── TNFα signaling
└── Homeostatic synaptic scaling
```

## 1. Entity Mapping Methodology

### Entity Identification Framework

```javascript
// Entity Mapping Configuration
const entityMappingStrategy = {
  
  // Step 1: Content Audit Classification
  contentAudit: {
    pages: [
      {
        url: "/about",
        primaryEntity: "Organization",
        secondaryEntities: ["Person", "Place"],
        contentType: "informational",
        priority: "high"
      },
      {
        url: "/products/*",
        primaryEntity: "Product",
        secondaryEntities: ["Offer", "Brand", "Review"],
        contentType: "transactional",
        priority: "critical"
      },
      {
        url: "/blog/*",
        primaryEntity: "Article",
        secondaryEntities: ["Person", "Organization", "ImageObject"],
        contentType: "editorial",
        priority: "medium"
      }
    ]
  },

  // Step 2: Entity Relationship Mapping
  entityRelationships: {
    "Organization": {
      relatedEntities: ["Person", "Place", "Product", "Service"],
      properties: {
        required: ["name", "url", "logo"],
        recommended: ["description", "sameAs", "contactPoint"],
        optional: ["founder", "foundingDate", "numberOfEmployees"]
      }
    },
    "Product": {
      relatedEntities: ["Offer", "Brand", "Review", "Organization"],
      properties: {
        required: ["name", "image", "description"],
        recommended: ["sku", "brand", "offers", "aggregateRating"],
        optional: ["review", "weight", "color", "material"]
      }
    },
    "Article": {
      relatedEntities: ["Person", "Organization", "ImageObject", "WebPage"],
      properties: {
        required: ["headline", "author", "datePublished", "image"],
        recommended: ["dateModified", "publisher", "description"],
        optional: ["articleSection", "wordCount", "keywords"]
      }
    }
  },

  // Step 3: Entity Priority Matrix
  priorityMatrix: {
    critical: {
      entities: ["Product", "LocalBusiness", "Organization"],
      reason: "Direct revenue/conversion impact",
      implementation: "immediate"
    },
    high: {
      entities: ["Article", "FAQPage", "HowTo"],
      reason: "Rich result eligibility",
      implementation: "phase1"
    },
    medium: {
      entities: ["BreadcrumbList", "WebSite", "SiteNavigationElement"],
      reason: "Site structure clarity",
      implementation: "phase2"
    },
    low: {
      entities: ["Event", "VideoObject", "Recipe"],
      reason: "Content-specific enhancement",
      implementation: "phase3"
    }
  }
};

### Automated Validation Script

```javascript
// Schema Validation Framework
class SchemaValidator {
  constructor(config) {
    this.config = config;
    this.validators = [];
    this.results = [];
  }

  // JSON Syntax Validation
  validateJsonSyntax(schemaString) {
    const result = {
      validator: 'JSON Syntax',
      passed: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: []
    };

    try {
      JSON.parse(schemaString);
    } catch (error) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.errors.push({
        type: 'INVALID_JSON',
        message: error.message,
        line: this.getErrorLine(error.message)
      });
    }

    return result;
  }

  // Schema.org Compliance Validation
  validateSchemaCompliance(schema) {
    const result = {
      validator: 'Schema.org Compliance',
      passed: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: []
    };

    // Check @context
    if (!schema['@context']) {
      result.errors.push({
        type: 'MISSING_CONTEXT',
        message: '@context is required'
      });
      result.passed = false;
    } else if (!schema['@context'].includes('schema.org')) {
      result.warnings.push({
        type: 'UNUSUAL_CONTEXT',
        message: 'Context does not reference schema.org'
      });
    }

    // Check @type
    if (!schema['@type'] && !schema['@graph']) {
      result.errors.push({
        type: 'MISSING_TYPE',
        message: '@type is required unless using @graph'
      });
      result.passed = false;
    }

    // Validate against schema.org vocabulary
    if (schema['@type']) {
      const validation = this.validateType(schema['@type'], schema);
      result.errors.push(...validation.errors);
      result.warnings.push(...validation.warnings);
      if (validation.errors.length > 0) result.passed = false;
    }

    return result;
  }

  // Type-specific validation
  validateType(type, schema) {
    const validation = { errors: [], warnings: [] };
    
    const typeRequirements = {
      'Product': {
        required: ['name', 'image'],
        recommended: ['description', 'sku', 'offers', 'brand'],
        googleRequired: ['name', 'image']
      },
      'Article': {
        required: ['headline', 'author', 'datePublished'],
        recommended: ['image', 'dateModified', 'publisher'],
        googleRequired: ['headline', 'image', 'datePublished', 'author']
      },
      'LocalBusiness': {
        required: ['name', 'address'],
        recommended: ['telephone', 'openingHours', 'geo', 'image'],
        googleRequired: ['name', 'address']
      },
      'FAQPage': {
        required: ['mainEntity'],
        recommended: [],
        googleRequired: ['mainEntity']
      },
      'Organization': {
        required: ['name'],
        recommended: ['url', 'logo', 'sameAs', 'contactPoint'],
        googleRequired: ['name', 'url', 'logo']
      },
      'Event': {
        required: ['name', 'startDate', 'location'],
        recommended: ['endDate', 'offers', 'performer', 'image'],
        googleRequired: ['name', 'startDate', 'location']
      },
      'HowTo': {
        required: ['name', 'step'],
        recommended: ['image', 'totalTime', 'supply', 'tool'],
        googleRequired: ['name', 'step']
      }
    };

    const requirements = typeRequirements[type];
    if (!requirements) {
      validation.warnings.push({
        type: 'UNKNOWN_TYPE',
        message: `Type "${type}" is not in common validation rules`
      });
      return validation;
    }

    // Check required fields
    requirements.required.forEach(field => {
      if (!schema[field]) {
        validation.errors.push({
          type: 'MISSING_REQUIRED',
          field: field,
          message: `Required field "${field}" is missing for type ${type}`
        });
      }
    });

    // Check recommended fields
    requirements.recommended.forEach(field => {
      if (!schema[field]) {
        validation.warnings.push({
          type: 'MISSING_RECOMMENDED',
          field: field,
          message: `Recommended field "${field}" is missing for type ${type}`
        });
      }
    });

    // Check Google requirements
    requirements.googleRequired.forEach(field => {
      if (!schema[field]) {
        validation.errors.push({
          type: 'GOOGLE_REQUIREMENT',
          field: field,
          message: `Google requires "${field}" for ${type} rich results`
        });
      }
    });

    return validation;
  }

  // Content alignment validation
  validateContentAlignment(schema, pageContent) {
    const result = {
      validator: 'Content Alignment',
      passed: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: []
    };

    // Check if schema content matches page content
    if (schema.name && !pageContent.includes(schema.name)) {
      result.warnings.push({
        type: 'NAME_NOT_VISIBLE',
        message: 'Schema name not found in visible page content'
      });
    }

    // Check for misleading prices
    if (schema.offers?.price) {
      const pricePattern = new RegExp(schema.offers.price.toString().replace('.', '\\.'));
      if (!pricePattern.test(pageContent)) {
        result.errors.push({
          type: 'PRICE_MISMATCH',
          message: 'Schema price does not match visible page price'
        });
        result.passed = false;
      }
    }

    // Check for valid URLs
    const urlFields = ['url', 'image', 'logo'];
    urlFields.forEach(field => {
      if (schema[field]) {
        const urls = Array.isArray(schema[field]) ? schema[field] : [schema[field]];
        urls.forEach(url => {
          if (typeof url === 'string' && !this.isValidUrl(url)) {
            result.errors.push({
              type: 'INVALID_URL',
              field: field,
              message: `Invalid URL format: ${url}`
            });
            result.passed = false;
          }
        });
      }
    });

    return result;
  }

  // Cross-site consistency validation
  validateConsistency(schemas) {
    const result = {
      validator: 'Cross-Site Consistency',
      passed: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: []
    };

    // Check organization consistency
    const orgSchemas = schemas.filter(s => s['@type'] === 'Organization');
    if (orgSchemas.length > 1) {
      const names = [...new Set(orgSchemas.map(s => s.name))];
      if (names.length > 1) {
        result.warnings.push({
          type: 'INCONSISTENT_ORG_NAME',
          message: `Multiple organization names found: ${names.join(', ')}`
        });
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  // Helper methods
  isValidUrl(string) {
    try {
      new URL(string);
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  getErrorLine(message) {
    const match = message.match(/position (\d+)/);
    return match ? parseInt(match[1]) : null;
  }

  // Run full validation
  async validate(schemaString, pageContent = '') {
    const results = [];

    // Step 1: JSON Syntax
    const syntaxResult = this.validateJsonSyntax(schemaString);
    results.push(syntaxResult);
    if (!syntaxResult.passed) {
      return { passed: false, results };
    }

    const schema = JSON.parse(schemaString);

    // Step 2: Schema.org Compliance
    results.push(this.validateSchemaCompliance(schema));

    // Step 3: Content Alignment
    if (pageContent) {
      results.push(this.validateContentAlignment(schema, pageContent));
    }

    const passed = results.every(r => r.passed);
    const totalErrors = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.errors.length, 0);
    const totalWarnings = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.warnings.length, 0);

    return {
      passed,
      totalErrors,
      totalWarnings,
      results,
      summary: this.generateSummary(results)
    };
  }

  generateSummary(results) {
    return {
      validatorsRun: results.length,
      validatorsPassed: results.filter(r => r.passed).length,
      criticalIssues: results.flatMap(r => 
        r.errors.filter(e => e.type.includes('GOOGLE') || e.type.includes('REQUIRED'))
      ),
      recommendations: results.flatMap(r => r.warnings)
    };
  }
}

// Usage Example
const validator = new SchemaValidator({
  strictMode: true,
  googleCompliance: true
});

const schemaToValidate = `{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Product",
  "name": "Wireless Headphones Pro",
  "image": "https://example.com/images/product.jpg",
  "description": "Premium wireless headphones",
  "sku": "WHP-2024",
  "offers": {
    "@type": "Offer",
    "price": 299.99,
    "priceCurrency": "USD",
    "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock"
  }
}`;

validator.validate(schemaToValidate, 'Page content with Wireless Headphones Pro for $299.99')
  .then(result => {
    console.log('Validation Result:', result);
  });
```

### Monitoring Implementation

```javascript
// Schema Monitoring System
class SchemaMonitor {
  constructor(config) {
    this.config = {
      siteUrl: config.siteUrl,
      gscCredentials: config.gscCredentials,
      alertThresholds: {
        errorRateIncrease: 0.05, // 5% increase triggers alert
        validPagesDecrease: 0.03, // 3% decrease triggers alert
        richResultDecrease: 0.10 // 10% decrease triggers alert
      },
      checkInterval: 3600000, // 1 hour
      ...config
    };
    
    this.metrics = {
      historical: [],
      current: null,
      alerts: []
    };
  }

  // Fetch Google Search Console data
  async fetchGSCData() {
    // Implementation would use Google Search Console API
    const response = await this.gscClient.searchanalytics.query({
      siteUrl: this.config.siteUrl,
      requestBody: {
        startDate: this.getDateString(-30),
        endDate: this.getDateString(0),
        dimensions: ['query', 'page'],
        searchType: 'web',
        rowLimit: 25000
      }
    });

    return response.data;
  }

  // Fetch rich results status
  async fetchRichResultsStatus() {
    const enhancements = await this.gscClient.urlInspection.index.inspect({
      siteUrl: this.config.siteUrl,
      inspectionUrl: this.config.siteUrl
    });

    // Aggregate enhancement reports
    const richResultTypes = [
      'Product',
      'Article', 
      'FAQPage',
      'HowTo',
      'LocalBusiness',
      'Event',
      'Review',
      'BreadcrumbList'
    ];

    const status = {};
    for (const type of richResultTypes) {
      status[type] = await this.getEnhancementReport(type);
    }

    return status;
  }

  // Crawl site for schema
  async crawlSiteSchema() {
    const pages = await this.getSitemapUrls();
    const results = [];

    for (const url of pages) {
      try {
        const pageData = await this.fetchPageSchema(url);
        results.push({
          url,
          hasSchema: pageData.schemas.length > 0,
          schemaTypes: pageData.schemas.map(s => s['@type']),
          validationResult: await this.validator.validate(JSON.stringify(pageData.schemas)),
          lastChecked: new Date().toISOString()
        });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({
          url,
          error: error.message,
          lastChecked: new Date().toISOString()
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  // Generate health score
  calculateHealthScore(data) {
    const weights = {
      validSchemaRatio: 0.25,
      requiredFieldsPresent: 0.25,
      richResultEligibility: 0.20,
      noErrors: 0.15,
      consistencyScore: 0.15
    };

    const scores = {
      validSchemaRatio: data.validPages / data.totalPages,
      requiredFieldsPresent: data.pagesWithRequiredFields / data.pagesWithSchema,
      richResultEligibility: data.richResultEligiblePages / data.pagesWithSchema,
      noErrors: 1 - (data.pagesWithErrors / data.pagesWithSchema),
      consistencyScore: this.calculateConsistencyScore(data)
    };

    let totalScore = 0;
    for (const [metric, weight] of Object.entries(weights)) {
      totalScore += scores[metric] * weight;
    }

    return Math.round(totalScore * 100);
  }

  // Check for alerts
  checkAlerts(currentMetrics, previousMetrics) {
    const alerts = [];

    // Error rate increase
    const errorRateChange = 
      (currentMetrics.errorRate - previousMetrics.errorRate) / previousMetrics.errorRate;
    
    if (errorRateChange > this.config.alertThresholds.errorRateIncrease) {
      alerts.push({
        severity: 'critical',
        type: 'ERROR_RATE_INCREASE',
        message: `Schema error rate increased by ${(errorRateChange * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
        currentValue: currentMetrics.errorRate,
        previousValue: previousMetrics.errorRate,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }

    // Valid pages decrease
    const validPagesChange = 
      (currentMetrics.validPages - previousMetrics.validPages) / previousMetrics.validPages;
    
    if (validPagesChange < -this.config.alertThresholds.validPagesDecrease) {
      alerts.push({
        severity: 'warning',
        type: 'VALID_PAGES_DECREASE',
        message: `Valid schema pages decreased by ${Math.abs(validPagesChange * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
        currentValue: currentMetrics.validPages,
        previousValue: previousMetrics.validPages,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }

    // Rich result eligibility decrease
    const richResultChange = 
      (currentMetrics.richResultPages - previousMetrics.richResultPages) / previousMetrics.richResultPages;
    
    if (richResultChange < -this.config.alertThresholds.richResultDecrease) {
      alerts.push({
        severity: 'critical',
        type: 'RICH_RESULT_DECREASE',
        message: `Rich result eligible pages decreased by ${Math.abs(richResultChange * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
        currentValue: currentMetrics.richResultPages,
        previousValue: previousMetrics.richResultPages,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }

    return alerts;
  }

  // Generate report
  generateReport() {
    const current = this.metrics.current;
    const historical = this.metrics.historical;
    const weekAgo = historical.find(h => 
      new Date(h.timestamp) <= new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    );

    return {
      summary: {
        healthScore: this.calculateHealthScore(current),
        totalPages: current.totalPages,
        pagesWithSchema: current.pagesWithSchema,
        validPages: current.validPages,
        richResultEligible: current.richResultPages,
        trends: weekAgo ? {
          healthScoreChange: current.healthScore - weekAgo.healthScore,
          validPagesChange: current.validPages - weekAgo.validPages,
          richResultChange: current.richResultPages - weekAgo.richResultPages
        } : null
      },
      
      bySchemaType: this.aggregateByType(current.pageDetails),
      
      issues: {
        critical: current.issues.filter(i => i.severity === 'critical'),
        warnings: current.issues.filter(i => i.severity === 'warning'),
        info: current.issues.filter(i => i.severity === 'info')
      },
      
      recommendations: this.generateRecommendations(current),
      
      activeAlerts: this.metrics.alerts.filter(a => !a.resolved),
      
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  // Automated recommendations
  generateRecommendations(metrics) {
    const recommendations = [];

    // Missing schema opportunities
    const pagesWithoutSchema = metrics.totalPages - metrics.pagesWithSchema;
    if (pagesWithoutSchema > 0) {
      recommendations.push({
        priority: 'high',
        type: 'MISSING_SCHEMA',
        title: 'Add schema to pages without structured data',
        description: `${pagesWithoutSchema} pages lack schema markup`,
        impact: 'Could increase rich result eligibility by ~15%',
        pages: metrics.pageDetails
          .filter(p => !p.hasSchema)
          .slice(0, 10)
          .map(p => p.url)
      });
    }

    // Missing recommended fields
    const productsMissingRating = metrics.pageDetails
      .filter(p => p.schemaTypes?.includes('Product') && !p.hasAggregateRating);
    
    if (productsMissingRating.length > 10) {
      recommendations.push({
        priority: 'medium',
        type: 'MISSING_AGGREGATE_RATING',
        title: 'Add aggregate ratings to product pages',
        description: `${productsMissingRating.length} products missing aggregateRating`,
        impact: 'Products with ratings see ~30% higher CTR',
        pages: productsMissingRating.slice(0, 10).map(p => p.url)
      });
    }

    // FAQ opportunities
    const articlePages = metrics.pageDetails
      .filter(p => p.schemaTypes?.includes('Article') && !p.schemaTypes?.includes('FAQPage'));
    
    if (articlePages.length > 20) {
      recommendations.push({
        priority: 'medium',
        type: 'FAQ_OPPORTUNITY',
        title: 'Add FAQ schema to informational content',
        description: `${articlePages.length} articles could benefit from FAQ schema`,
        impact: 'FAQ rich results increase CTR by 40%+ on average'
      });
    }

    return recommendations;
  }

  // Start monitoring
  async start() {
    await this.runCheck();
    setInterval(() => this.runCheck(), this.config.checkInterval);
  }

  async runCheck() {
    try {
      // Collect current metrics
      const [gscData, richResults, siteSchema] = await Promise.all([
        this.fetchGSCData(),
        this.fetchRichResultsStatus(),
        this.crawlSiteSchema()
      ]);

      const currentMetrics = this.processMetrics(gscData, richResults, siteSchema);

      // Check for alerts
      if (this.metrics.current) {
        const newAlerts = this.checkAlerts(currentMetrics, this.metrics.current);
        this.metrics.alerts.push(...newAlerts);
        
        // Send notifications for critical alerts
        for (const alert of newAlerts.filter(a => a.severity === 'critical')) {
          await this.sendAlert(alert);
        }
      }

      // Store metrics
      this.metrics.historical.push({
        ...this.metrics.current,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });
      this.metrics.current = currentMetrics;

      // Keep only 90 days of history
      const cutoff = Date.now() - 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      this.metrics.historical = this.metrics.historical.filter(
        h => new Date(h.timestamp) > cutoff
      );

      console.log('Schema monitoring check completed:', new Date().toISOString());
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Schema monitoring error:', error);
    }
  }
}

// Initialize monitor
const monitor = new SchemaMonitor({
  siteUrl: 'https://example.com',
  gscCredentials: './credentials.json'
});

monitor.start();

// Schema Impact Measurement System
class SchemaImpactMeasurement {
  constructor(config) {
    this.config = config;
    this.analytics = config.analyticsClient;
    this.searchConsole = config.gscClient;
  }

  // Calculate CTR lift from schema implementation
  async calculateCTRLift(schemaType, dateRange = 30) {
    // Get pages by schema status
    const pagesWithSchema = await this.getPagesWithSchema(schemaType);
    const pagesWithoutSchema = await this.getPagesWithoutSchema(schemaType);

    const startDate = this.getDateString(-dateRange);
    const endDate = this.getDateString(0);

    // Fetch GSC data for pages with schema
    const withSchemaMetrics = await this.getAggregatedMetrics(
      pagesWithSchema,
      startDate,
      endDate
    );

    // Fetch GSC data for pages without schema  
    const withoutSchemaMetrics = await this.getAggregatedMetrics(
      pagesWithoutSchema,
      startDate,
      endDate
    );

    const ctrLift = (withSchemaMetrics.ctr - withoutSchemaMetrics.ctr) / withoutSchemaMetrics.ctr;

    return {
      schemaType,
      dateRange,
      pagesWithSchema: pagesWithSchema.length,
      pagesWithoutSchema: pagesWithoutSchema.length,
      metrics: {
        withSchema: {
          impressions: withSchemaMetrics.impressions,
          clicks: withSchemaMetrics.clicks,
          ctr: withSchemaMetrics.ctr,
          avgPosition: withSchemaMetrics.position
        },
        withoutSchema: {
          impressions: withoutSchemaMetrics.impressions,
          clicks: withoutSchemaMetrics.clicks,
          ctr: withoutSchemaMetrics.ctr,
          avgPosition: withoutSchemaMetrics.position
        }
      },
      lift: {
        ctr: ctrLift,
        ctrPercentage: `${(ctrLift * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
        additionalClicks: withSchemaMetrics.clicks - 
          (withSchemaMetrics.impressions * withoutSchemaMetrics.ctr)
      }
    };
  }

  // Estimate revenue impact
  async estimateRevenueImpact(schemaType, dateRange = 30) {
    const ctrData = await this.calculateCTRLift(schemaType, dateRange);
    
    // Get conversion and revenue data from analytics
    const conversionData = await this.getConversionData(
      await this.getPagesWithSchema(schemaType),
      dateRange
    );

    const additionalClicks = ctrData.lift.additionalClicks;
    const conversionRate = conversionData.conversionRate;
    const avgOrderValue = conversionData.avgOrderValue;

    const estimatedAdditionalConversions = additionalClicks * conversionRate;
    const estimatedRevenueImpact = estimatedAdditionalConversions * avgOrderValue;

    return {
      schemaType,
      dateRange,
      ...ctrData,
      revenue: {
        additionalClicks,
        conversionRate: `${(conversionRate * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
        avgOrderValue: `$${avgOrderValue.toFixed(2)}`,
        estimatedAdditionalConversions: Math.round(estimatedAdditionalConversions),
        estimatedRevenueImpact: `$${estimatedRevenueImpact.toFixed(2)}`,
        monthlyProjection: `$${(estimatedRevenueImpact).toFixed(2)}`,
        annualProjection: `$${(estimatedRevenueImpact * 12).toFixed(2)}`
      }
    };
  }

  // Rich result tracking
  async trackRichResults(dateRange = 30) {
    const richResultTypes = [
      { type: 'Product', searchAppearance: 'PRODUCT_SNIPPET' },
      { type: 'FAQ', searchAppearance: 'FAQ_RICH_RESULT' },
      { type: 'HowTo', searchAppearance: 'HOWTO_RICH_RESULT' },
      { type: 'Review', searchAppearance: 'REVIEW_SNIPPET' },
      { type: 'Recipe', searchAppearance: 'RECIPE_RICH_RESULT' }
    ];

    const results = [];

    for (const richResult of richResultTypes) {
      const data = await this.searchConsole.searchanalytics.query({
        siteUrl: this.config.siteUrl,
        requestBody: {
          startDate: this.getDateString(-dateRange),
          endDate: this.getDateString(0),
          dimensions: ['page', 'searchAppearance'],
          dimensionFilterGroups: [{
            filters: [{
              dimension: 'searchAppearance',
              operator: 'equals',
              expression: richResult.searchAppearance
            }]
          }]
        }
      });

      if (data.rows) {
        const aggregated = data.rows.reduce((acc, row) => ({
          impressions: acc.impressions + row.impressions,
          clicks: acc.clicks + row.clicks,
          position: acc.position + (row.position * row.impressions)
        }), { impressions: 0, clicks: 0, position: 0 });

        results.push({
          type: richResult.type,
          pages: data.rows.length,
          impressions: aggregated.impressions,
          clicks: aggregated.clicks,
          ctr: (aggregated.clicks / aggregated.impressions * 100).toFixed(2) + '%',
          avgPosition: (aggregated.position / aggregated.impressions).toFixed(1)
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  // A/B test analysis
  async analyzeABTest(testConfig) {
    const { controlPages, testPages, startDate, endDate } = testConfig;

    const controlMetrics = await this.getAggregatedMetrics(controlPages, startDate, endDate);
    const testMetrics = await this.getAggregatedMetrics(testPages, startDate, endDate);

    // Statistical significance calculation
    const significance = this.calculateStatisticalSignificance(
      controlMetrics,
      testMetrics
    );

    const lift = {
      ctr: ((testMetrics.ctr - controlMetrics.ctr) / controlMetrics.ctr * 100).toFixed(1),
      impressions: ((testMetrics.impressions - controlMetrics.impressions) / 
        controlMetrics.impressions * 100).toFixed(1),
      clicks: ((testMetrics.clicks - controlMetrics.clicks) / 
        controlMetrics.clicks * 100).toFixed(1)
    };

    return {
      testConfig: {
        controlPages: controlPages.length,
        testPages: testPages.length,
        duration: this.daysBetween(startDate, endDate),
        startDate,
        endDate
      },
      control: controlMetrics,
      test: testMetrics,
      lift,
      significance,
      recommendation: this.getRecommendation(lift, significance)
    };
  }

  calculateStatisticalSignificance(control, test) {
    // Using chi-squared test for CTR comparison
    const n1 = control.impressions;
    const n2 = test.impressions;
    const x1 = control.clicks;
    const x2 = test.clicks;

    const p1 = x1 / n1;
    const p2 = x2 / n2;
    const p = (x1 + x2) / (n1 + n2);

    const se = Math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) * (1/n1 + 1/n2));
    const z = (p2 - p1) / se;

    // Convert z-score to confidence
    const confidence = this.zToConfidence(Math.abs(z));

    return {
      zScore: z.toFixed(2),
      confidence: `${(confidence * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
      isSignificant: confidence >= 0.95
    };
  }

  zToConfidence(z) {
    // Approximation of normal CDF
    const a1 = 0.254829592;
    const a2 = -0.284496736;
    const a3 = 1.421413741;
    const a4 = -1.453152027;
    const a5 = 1.061405429;
    const p = 0.3275911;

    const sign = z < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    z = Math.abs(z) / Math.sqrt(2);

    const t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * z);
    const y = 1.0 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-z * z);

    return 0.5 * (1.0 + sign * y);
  }

  getRecommendation(lift, significance) {
    if (!significance.isSignificant) {
      return {
        decision: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
        action: 'Continue testing or increase sample size',
        reason: `Confidence level (${significance.confidence}) below 95% threshold`
      };
    }

    if (parseFloat(lift.ctr) > 0) {
      return {
        decision: 'WINNER',
        action: 'Implement schema across all similar pages',
        reason: `Significant CTR improvement of ${lift.ctr}% with ${significance.confidence} confidence`
      };
    }

    return {
      decision: 'LOSER',
      action: 'Do not implement; review schema for issues',
      reason: `Schema implementation showed negative impact`
    };
  }

  // Generate comprehensive impact report
  async generateImpactReport() {
    const schemaTypes = ['Product', 'Article', 'FAQPage', 'LocalBusiness', 'HowTo'];
    const report = {
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      dateRange: 30,
      summary: {},
      bySchemaType: {},
      richResults: {},
      recommendations: []
    };

    // Overall metrics
    let totalImpact = 0;
    let totalAdditionalClicks = 0;

    for (const schemaType of schemaTypes) {
      const impact = await this.estimateRevenueImpact(schemaType, 30);
      report.bySchemaType[schemaType] = impact;
      
      totalAdditionalClicks += impact.lift.additionalClicks;
      totalImpact += parseFloat(impact.revenue.estimatedRevenueImpact.replace('$', ''));
    }

    report.summary = {
      totalSchemaTypes: schemaTypes.length,
      totalAdditionalClicks,
      estimatedMonthlyRevenueImpact: `$${totalImpact.toFixed(2)}`,
      estimatedAnnualRevenueImpact: `$${(totalImpact * 12).toFixed(2)}`
    };

    // Rich results performance
    report.richResults = await this.trackRichResults(30);

    // Generate recommendations
    report.recommendations = this.generateRecommendations(report);

    return report;
  }

  generateRecommendations(report) {
    const recommendations = [];

    // Find schema types with high ROI potential
    for (const [schemaType, data] of Object.entries(report.bySchemaType)) {
      if (data.lift.ctr > 0.3 && data.pagesWithoutSchema > 10) {
        recommendations.push({
          priority: 'high',
          type: 'EXPANSION',
          schemaType,
          action: `Implement ${schemaType} schema on remaining ${data.pagesWithoutSchema} pages`,
          estimatedImpact: `+${Math.round(data.pagesWithoutSchema * data.lift.additionalClicks / data.pagesWithSchema)} clicks/month`
        });
      }
    }

    // Find underperforming schema types
    for (const [schemaType, data] of Object.entries(report.bySchemaType)) {
      if (data.lift.ctr < 0.1 && data.pagesWithSchema > 20) {
        recommendations.push({
          priority: 'medium',
          type: 'OPTIMIZATION',
          schemaType,
          action: `Review and enhance ${schemaType} schema implementation`,
          issue: 'Lower than expected CTR lift suggests schema may need optimization'
        });
      }
    }

    return recommendations;
  }

  // Helper methods
  getDateString(daysOffset) {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setDate(date.getDate() + daysOffset);
    return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  }

  daysBetween(start, end) {
    return Math.round((new Date(end) - new Date(start)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  }
}

### 1.2 License Family Definitions

#### Public Domain / No Attribution

characteristics:

  - No attribution required (though often appreciated)

#### Permissive Licenses

```yaml
family: "Permissive"
characteristics:
  - Minimal restrictions
  - Attribution typically required
  - License text inclusion often required
  - No copyleft/source disclosure requirements
  - Can be combined with proprietary code

licenses:
  mit:
    spdx_id: "MIT"
    also_known_as: ["Expat License", "X11 License"]
    key_requirements:
      - Include copyright notice
      - Include license text
    patent_grant: "Implicit (debated)"
    
  bsd_2_clause:
    spdx_id: "BSD-2-Clause"
    also_known_as: ["Simplified BSD", "FreeBSD License"]
    key_requirements:
      - Include copyright notice
      - Include license text (source)
      - Include copyright in docs (binary)
      
  bsd_3_clause:
    spdx_id: "BSD-3-Clause"
    also_known_as: ["Modified BSD", "New BSD"]
    key_requirements:
      - Same as BSD-2-Clause
      - No use of contributor names for endorsement
      
  apache_2:
    spdx_id: "Apache-2.0"
    key_requirements:
      - Include copyright notice
      - Include license text
      - State changes made
      - Include NOTICE file if present
    patent_grant: "Explicit"
    patent_retaliation: true
    note: "Often preferred for patent protection"
    
  isc:
    spdx_id: "ISC"
    key_requirements:
      - Include copyright notice
      - Include license text
    note: "Functionally equivalent to MIT"
    
  zlib:
    spdx_id: "Zlib"
    key_requirements:
      - Altered versions must be marked
      - Copyright notice in source
    note: "Common in game development"

#### Weak Copyleft Licenses

```yaml
family: "Weak Copyleft"

  - Larger works can be under different licenses
  - Boundary typically at file or library level

      - Attribution and license inclusion
    linking_exception: "Dynamic linking typically safe"
    static_linking: "May trigger additional obligations"
    
  lgpl_3:
    spdx_id: "LGPL-3.0-only"  # or LGPL-3.0-or-later
    scope: "Library/module level"
    key_requirements:
      - Same as LGPL-2.1
      - Patent provisions
      - Installation information for "User Products"
    note: "More detailed boundary definition"
    
  mpl_2:
    spdx_id: "MPL-2.0"
    scope: "File level"
    key_requirements:
      - MPL'd files must remain under MPL
      - Source for MPL files must be available
      - Can combine with other licenses
    explicit_compatibility: ["GPL-2.0+", "LGPL-2.1+", "AGPL-3.0"]
    secondary_license: "Allows GPL compatibility"
    
  epl_2:
    spdx_id: "EPL-2.0"
    scope: "Module level"
    key_requirements:
      - Source for EPL'd code
      - Commercial distribution requires patent license
    secondary_license: "GPL-2.0 compatible option"
    
  cddl_1:
    spdx_id: "CDDL-1.0"
    scope: "File level"
    key_requirements:
      - Modified files under CDDL
      - Source availability
    gpl_compatible: false
    note: "Cannot combine with GPL code"
```

#### Strong Copyleft Licenses

```yaml
family: "Strong Copyleft"
characteristics:

  - Source code must be provided

```python
# build_attribution.py
"""
Script to generate attribution files for compiled applications.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

class AttributionGenerator:
    def __init__(self, dependency_file: str):
        with open(dependency_file) as f:
            self.dependencies = json.load(f)
    
    def generate_about_dialog_text(self) -> str:
        """Generate text suitable for About dialog."""
        lines = [
            "=" * 60,
            "OPEN SOURCE LICENSES",
            "=" * 60,
            "",
            "This application uses the following open source software:",
            ""
        ]
        
        # Group by license
        by_license = {}
        for dep in self.dependencies['dependencies']:
            license_id = dep['license']['spdxId']
            if license_id not in by_license:
                by_license[license_id] = []
            by_license[license_id].append(dep)
        
        for license_id, deps in sorted(by_license.items()):
            lines.append(f"--- {license_id} ---")
            for dep in deps:
                copyright_line = dep.get('copyright', 'Unknown')
                lines.append(f"  • {dep['name']} {dep['version']}")
                lines.append(f"    {copyright_line}")
            lines.append("")
        
        lines.extend([
            "=" * 60,
            "Full license texts are available at:",
            "[Help] > [Open Source Licenses] or in LICENSES.txt",
            "=" * 60
        ])
        
        return "\n".join(lines)
    
    def generate_html_credits(self) -> str:
        """Generate HTML credits page."""
        html = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Open Source Licenses</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; }
    .component { border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; padding: 15px 0; }
    .component-name { font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em; }
    .license-badge { 
      display: inline-block; 
      background: #e3f2fd; 
      padding: 2px 8px; 
      border-radius: 4px; 
      font-size: 0.85em; 
    }
    .copyright { color: #666; font-size: 0.9em; }
    details { margin-top: 10px; }
    summary { cursor: pointer; color: #1976d2; }
    pre { background: #f5f5f5; padding: 15px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 0.8em; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>Open Source Licenses</h1>
  <p>This application includes the following open source components:</p>
"""
        
        for dep in self.dependencies['dependencies']:
            html += f"""
  <div class="component">
    <div class="component-name">{dep['name']} <span style="color: #888">v{dep['version']}</span></div>
    <span class="license-badge">{dep['license']['spdxId']}</span>
    <div class="copyright">{dep.get('copyright', '')}</div>
    <details>
      <summary>View License</summary>
      <pre>{self._get_license_text(dep['license']['spdxId'])}</pre>
    </details>
  </div>
"""
        
        html += """
</body>
</html>"""
        return html
    
    def generate_android_notices(self) -> str:
        """Generate Android play_licensing format."""
        # Android uses a specific format for the OSS licenses activity
        notices = []
        for dep in self.dependencies['dependencies']:
            notices.append({
                "libraryName": dep['name'],
                "libraryVersion": dep['version'],
                "copyrightHolder": dep.get('copyright', ''),
                "license": dep['license']['spdxId'],
                "licenseText": self._get_license_text(dep['license']['spdxId'])
            })
        return json.dumps(notices, indent=2)
    
    def generate_ios_settings_bundle(self) -> dict:
        """Generate iOS Settings bundle format."""
        return {
            "PreferenceSpecifiers": [
                {"Type": "PSGroupSpecifier", "Title": "Licenses"},
                *[{
                    "Type": "PSChildPaneSpecifier",
                    "Title": dep['name'],
                    "File": f"Licenses/{dep['name']}"
                } for dep in self.dependencies['dependencies']]
            ]
        }
    
    def _get_license_text(self, spdx_id: str) -> str:
        """Get full license text for an SPDX ID."""
        return self.dependencies.get('licenseTexts', {}).get(spdx_id, 
            f"See https://spdx.org/licenses/{spdx_id}.html")


# Generate attribution files
if __name__ == "__main__":
    generator = AttributionGenerator("dependencies.json")
    
    Path("dist/NOTICES.txt").write_text(generator.generate_about_dialog_text())
    Path("dist/licenses.html").write_text(generator.generate_html_credits())
    Path("dist/android-notices.json").write_text(generator.generate_android_notices())

### 4.3 Copyleft Boundary Examples

```python
"""
Copyleft Boundary Analysis Examples

This module demonstrates various integration scenarios
and their copyleft implications.
"""

# ============================================================================
# SAFE PATTERNS (Generally no copyleft trigger)
# ============================================================================

# Pattern 1: Command-line tool invocation
import subprocess

def convert_image_safe(input_path: str, output_path: str) -> bool:
    """
    Using GPL ImageMagick via subprocess.
    This is generally safe - truly separate programs communicating via CLI.
    """
    result = subprocess.run(
        ['convert', input_path, '-resize', '50%', output_path],
        capture_output=True
    )
    return result.returncode == 0


# Pattern 2: Network API call
import requests

def gpl_service_query_safe(query: str) -> dict:
    """
    Calling a GPL-licensed service over HTTP.
    GPL/LGPL: No trigger (not distribution)
    AGPL: The SERVER operator has obligations, not the client
    """
    response = requests.post(
        'http://gpl-service.example.com/api/search',
        json={'query': query}
    )
    return response.json()


# Pattern 3: Dynamic linking with LGPL (properly done)
import ctypes

class LGPLLibraryWrapper:
    """
    Proper LGPL dynamic linking.
    User can replace the library with compatible version.
    """
    def __init__(self):
        # Load shared library at runtime
        self._lib = ctypes.CDLL("liblgpl_component.so")
        
        # Define function signatures
        self._lib.lgpl_function.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int]
        self._lib.lgpl_function.restype = ctypes.c_int
    
    def call_function(self, value: int) -> int:
        return self._lib.lgpl_function(value)

# ============================================================================

WARNING: If you statically link LGPL code, you must either:
1. Provide object files allowing users to relink
2. Provide complete source code
3. Use dynamic linking instead

Example of problematic compilation:
$ gcc myapp.c -static -llgpl_library -o myapp

"""

may create a derivative work.

    // Substantial implementation here

"""

### 5.2 Multi-Ecosystem Scanner Script

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Multi-Ecosystem License Scanner

Scans project dependencies across multiple package managers
and generates unified compliance reports.
"""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional
from enum import Enum
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import tomllib
import re

class LicenseCategory(Enum):
    PERMISSIVE = "permissive"
    WEAK_COPYLEFT = "weak_copyleft"
    STRONG_COPYLEFT = "strong_copyleft"
    NETWORK_COPYLEFT = "network_copyleft"
    PROPRIETARY = "proprietary"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"

LICENSE_CATEGORIES = {
    # Permissive
    "MIT": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "Apache-2.0": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "BSD-2-Clause": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "BSD-3-Clause": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "ISC": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "Zlib": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "Unlicense": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "CC0-1.0": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    "0BSD": LicenseCategory.PERMISSIVE,
    
    # Weak Copyleft
    "LGPL-2.0": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    "LGPL-2.1": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    "LGPL-3.0": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    "MPL-2.0": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    "EPL-1.0": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    "EPL-2.0": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    "CDDL-1.0": LicenseCategory.WEAK_COPYLEFT,
    
    # Strong Copyleft
    "GPL-2.0": LicenseCategory.STRONG_COPYLEFT,
    "GPL-2.0-only": LicenseCategory.STRONG_COPYLEFT,
    "GPL-2.0-or-later": LicenseCategory.STRONG_COPYLEFT,
    "GPL-3.0": LicenseCategory.STRONG_COPYLEFT,
    "GPL-3.0-only": LicenseCategory.STRONG_COPYLEFT,
    "GPL-3.0-or-later": LicenseCategory.STRONG_COPYLEFT,
    
    # Network Copyleft
    "AGPL-3.0": LicenseCategory.NETWORK_COPYLEFT,
    "AGPL-3.0-only": LicenseCategory.NETWORK_COPYLEFT,
    "AGPL-3.0-or-later": LicenseCategory.NETWORK_COPYLEFT,
}

@dataclass
class Dependency:
    name: str
    version: str
    license_id: str
    ecosystem: str
    direct: bool = True
    path: Optional[str] = None
    repository: Optional[str] = None
    
    @property
    def category(self) -> LicenseCategory:
        # Normalize license ID
        normalized = self.license_id.upper().replace(" ", "-")
        for known, category in LICENSE_CATEGORIES.items():
            if known.upper() in normalized:
                return category
        return LicenseCategory.UNKNOWN


@dataclass
class ScanResult:
    project_path: str
    ecosystems_scanned: list = field(default_factory=list)
    dependencies: list = field(default_factory=list)
    errors: list = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def add_dependency(self, dep: Dependency):
        self.dependencies.append(dep)
    
    def get_by_category(self) -> dict:
        result = {cat: [] for cat in LicenseCategory}
        for dep in self.dependencies:
            result[dep.category].append(dep)
        return result
    
    def get_policy_violations(self, blocked_categories: list) -> list:
        violations = []
        for dep in self.dependencies:
            if dep.category in blocked_categories:
                violations.append(dep)
        return violations


class EcosystemScanner:
    """Base class for ecosystem-specific scanners."""
    
    ecosystem_name = "base"
    
    def detect(self, project_path: Path) -> bool:
        raise NotImplementedError
    
    def scan(self, project_path: Path) -> list[Dependency]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class NpmScanner(EcosystemScanner):
    ecosystem_name = "npm"
    
    def detect(self, project_path: Path) -> bool:
        return (project_path / "package.json").exists()
    
    def scan(self, project_path: Path) -> list[Dependency]:
        dependencies = []
        
        # Use npm ls for direct deps, license-checker for all
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["npx", "license-checker", "--json", "--production"],
                cwd=project_path,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=True
            )
            
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            
            # Get direct dependencies from package.json
            with open(project_path / "package.json") as f:
                pkg = json.load(f)
            direct_deps = set(pkg.get("dependencies", {}).keys())
            
            for name_version, info in data.items():
                parts = name_version.rsplit("@", 1)
                name = parts[0]
                version = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "unknown"
                
                dependencies.append(Dependency(
                    name=name,
                    version=version,
                    license_id=info.get("licenses", "UNKNOWN"),
                    ecosystem="npm",
                    direct=name in direct_deps,
                    path=info.get("path"),
                    repository=info.get("repository")
                ))
                
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"Warning: npm scan error: {e}")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # license-checker not installed, use basic scanning
            pass
            
        return dependencies


class PythonScanner(EcosystemScanner):
    ecosystem_name = "python"
    
    def detect(self, project_path: Path) -> bool:
        indicators = [
            "requirements.txt", "setup.py", "pyproject.toml",
            "Pipfile", "setup.cfg"
        ]
        return any((project_path / f).exists() for f in indicators)
    
    def scan(self, project_path: Path) -> list[Dependency]:
        dependencies = []
        
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["pip-licenses", "--format=json", "--with-urls"],
                cwd=project_path,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=True
            )
            
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            
            for pkg in data:
                dependencies.append(Dependency(
                    name=pkg.get("Name", "unknown"),
                    version=pkg.get("Version", "unknown"),
                    license_id=pkg.get("License", "UNKNOWN"),
                    ecosystem="python",
                    repository=pkg.get("URL")
                ))
                
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            print(f"Warning: Python scan limited: {e}")
            
        return dependencies


class CargoScanner(EcosystemScanner):
    ecosystem_name = "rust"
    
    def detect(self, project_path: Path) -> bool:
        return (project_path / "Cargo.toml").exists()
    
    def scan(self, project_path: Path) -> list[Dependency]:
        dependencies = []
        
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version=1"],
                cwd=project_path,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=True
            )
            
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            
            for pkg in data.get("packages", []):
                if pkg.get("source"):  # External dependency
                    dependencies.append(Dependency(
                        name=pkg.get("name"),
                        version=pkg.get("version"),
                        license_id=pkg.get("license", "UNKNOWN"),
                        ecosystem="rust",
                        repository=pkg.get("repository")
                    ))
                    
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            print(f"Warning: Cargo scan error: {e}")
            
        return dependencies


class GoScanner(EcosystemScanner):
    ecosystem_name = "go"
    
    def detect(self, project_path: Path) -> bool:
        return (project_path / "go.mod").exists()
    
    def scan(self, project_path: Path) -> list[Dependency]:
        dependencies = []
        
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["go", "list", "-m", "-json", "all"],
                cwd=project_path,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=True
            )
            
            # Parse NDJSON output
            for line in result.stdout.strip().split("\n"):
                if line:
                    module = json.loads(line)
                    if not module.get("Main"):  # Skip main module
                        dependencies.append(Dependency(
                            name=module.get("Path"),
                            version=module.get("Version", "unknown"),
                            license_id="UNKNOWN",  # Need separate detection
                            ecosystem="go",
                            direct=not module.get("Indirect", False)
                        ))
                        
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            print(f"Warning: Go scan error: {e}")
            
        return dependencies


class MavenScanner(EcosystemScanner):
    ecosystem_name = "maven"
    
    def detect(self, project_path: Path) -> bool:
        return (project_path / "pom.xml").exists()
    
    def scan(self, project_path: Path) -> list[Dependency]:
        dependencies = []
        
        try:
            result = subprocess.run([
                "mvn", "license:download-licenses", 
                "license:add-third-party",
                "-DskipTests"
            ], cwd=project_path, capture_output=True, check=True)
            
            # Parse generated third-party file
            third_party = project_path / "target" / "generated-sources" / "license" / "THIRD-PARTY.txt"
            if third_party.exists():
                content = third_party.read_text()
                # Parse the format: (License) group:artifact:version
                pattern = r'\(([^)]+)\)\s+(\S+):(\S+):(\S+)'
                for match in re.finditer(pattern, content):
                    license_id, group, artifact, version = match.groups()
                    dependencies.append(Dependency(
                        name=f"{group}:{artifact}",
                        version=version,
                        license_id=license_id,
                        ecosystem="maven"
                    ))
                    
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            print(f"Warning: Maven scan error: {e}")
            
        return dependencies


class MultiEcosystemScanner:
    """Coordinates scanning across multiple ecosystems."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.scanners = [
            NpmScanner(),
            PythonScanner(),
            CargoScanner(),
            GoScanner(),
            MavenScanner(),
        ]
    
    def scan_project(self, project_path: str) -> ScanResult:
        path = Path(project_path)
        result = ScanResult(project_path=project_path)
        
        for scanner in self.scanners:
            if scanner.detect(path):
                print(f"Detected {scanner.ecosystem_name} project")
                result.ecosystems_scanned.append(scanner.ecosystem_name)
                
                try:
                    deps = scanner.scan(path)
                    for dep in deps:
                        result.add_dependency(dep)
                    print(f"  Found {len(deps)} dependencies")
                except Exception as e:
                    result.errors.append(f"{scanner.ecosystem_name}: {str(e)}")
        
        return result
    
    def generate_report(self, result: ScanResult, output_format: str = "json"):
        if output_format == "json":
            return self._json_report(result)
        elif output_format == "markdown":
            return self._markdown_report(result)
        elif output_format == "spdx":
            return self._spdx_report(result)
    
    def _json_report(self, result: ScanResult) -> str:
        by_category = result.get_by_category()
        
        return json.dumps({
            "project": result.project_path,
            "ecosystems": result.ecosystems_scanned,
            "summary": {
                "total": len(result.dependencies),
                "by_category": {
                    cat.value: len(deps) 
                    for cat, deps in by_category.items()
                }
            },
            "dependencies": [
                {
                    "name": d.name,
                    "version": d.version,
                    "license": d.license_id,
                    "category": d.category.value,
                    "ecosystem": d.ecosystem,
                    "direct": d.direct
                }
                for d in result.dependencies
            ],
            "errors": result.errors
        }, indent=2)
    
    def _markdown_report(self, result: ScanResult) -> str:
        by_category = result.get_by_category()
        
        lines = [
            "# License Compliance Report\n",
            f"**Project:** {result.project_path}\n",
            f"**Ecosystems:** {', '.join(result.ecosystems_scanned)}\n",
            f"**Total Dependencies:** {len(result.dependencies)}\n",
            "\n## Summary by Category\n",
            "| Category | Count |",
            "|----------|-------|",
        ]
        
        for cat in LicenseCategory:
            lines.append(f"| {cat.value} | {len(by_category[cat])} |")
        
        lines.extend(["\n## Dependencies\n"])
        
        for cat in LicenseCategory:
            if by_category[cat]:
                lines.append(f"\n### {cat.value.replace('_', ' ').title()}\n")
                lines.append("| Package | Version | License | Ecosystem |")
                lines.append("|---------|---------|---------|-----------|")
                for dep in by_category[cat]:
                    lines.append(f"| {dep.name} | {dep.version} | {dep.license_id} | {dep.ecosystem} |")
        
        return "\n".join(lines)


# CLI Entry Point
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Multi-ecosystem license scanner")
    parser.add_argument("path", help="Project path to scan")
    parser.add_argument("-f", "--format", choices=["json", "markdown", "spdx"], 
                       default="json", help="Output format")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output file (default: stdout)")
    parser.add_argument("--blocked", nargs="*", 
                       choices=["strong_copyleft", "network_copyleft", "unknown"],
                       help="Categories to flag as violations")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    scanner = MultiEcosystemScanner()
    result = scanner.scan_project(args.path)
    
    report = scanner.generate_report(result, args.format)
    
    if args.output:
        Path(args.output).write_text(report)
    else:
        print(report)
    
    if args.blocked:
        blocked = [LicenseCategory[c.upper()] for c in args.blocked]
        violations = result.get_policy_violations(blocked)
        if violations:
            print(f"\n⚠️  Found {len(violations)} policy violations!", file=sys.stderr)
            for v in violations:
                print(f"  - {v.name}@{v.version}: {v.license_id}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

        id: scan
        run: |
          python scripts/license_scanner.py . \
            --format json \
            --output license-report.json \
            --blocked strong_copyleft network_copyleft unknown
            
      - name: Upload license report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: license-report
          path: license-report.json
          
      - name: Post PR comment with summary
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('license-report.json'));
            
            const summary = Object.entries(report.summary.by_category)
              .map(([cat, count]) => `- **${cat}**: ${count}`)
              .join('\n');
            
            const body = `## 📋 License Compliance Report
            
            **Total dependencies:** ${report.summary.total}
            
            ### By Category
            ${summary}
            
            <details>
            <summary>View full report</summary>
            
            \`\`\`json
            ${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}
            \`\`\`
            </details>`;
            
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: body
            });

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Find alternatives for dependencies with problematic licenses.
"""

import requests
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import json

@dataclass
class Alternative:
    name: str
    description: str
    license: str
    stars: int
    url: str
    ecosystem: str
    similarity_score: float

class AlternativeFinder:
    """Find alternative packages with different licenses."""
    
    SAFE_LICENSES = {
        "MIT", "Apache-2.0", "BSD-2-Clause", "BSD-3-Clause",
        "ISC", "Zlib", "Unlicense", "CC0-1.0", "0BSD"
    }
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.session = requests.Session()
    
    def find_npm_alternatives(self, package_name: str, 
                              keywords: list[str]) -> list[Alternative]:
        """Search npm registry for alternatives."""
        alternatives = []
        
        # Search npm registry
        search_url = "https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search"
        
        for keyword in keywords:
            params = {"text": keyword, "size": 20}
            response = self.session.get(search_url, params=params)
            
            if response.ok:
                data = response.json()
                for obj in data.get("objects", []):
                    pkg = obj.get("package", {})
                    license_id = pkg.get("license", "")
                    
                    if license_id in self.SAFE_LICENSES:
                        alternatives.append(Alternative(
                            name=pkg.get("name"),
                            description=pkg.get("description", ""),
                            license=license_id,
                            stars=obj.get("score", {}).get("detail", {}).get("popularity", 0),
                            url=pkg.get("links", {}).get("npm", ""),
                            ecosystem="npm",
                            similarity_score=obj.get("score", {}).get("final", 0)

        seen = set()
        unique = []
        for alt in sorted(alternatives, key=lambda x: -x.similarity_score):

        """Generate a migration guide between packages."""
        
        guide = f"""# Migration Guide: {old_pkg} → {new_pkg}

## Overview

This guide helps migrate from `{old_pkg}` (with problematic license) 
to `{new_pkg}` (with permissive license).

```bash

{"npm uninstall " + old_pkg if ecosystem == "npm" else "pip uninstall " + old_pkg}

### 7.2 Developer Guidelines Document

```markdown
# Developer Open Source Guidelines

## Quick Reference

### ✅ Safe to Use (No approval needed)
- MIT
- Apache 2.0
- BSD (2-clause, 3-clause)
- ISC
- Zlib
- CC0 / Unlicense

### ⚠️ Use with Caution (Architecture review needed)
- LGPL 2.1/3.0 → Dynamic linking only
- MPL 2.0 → File-level isolation
- EPL 2.0 → Module isolation

### ❌ Do Not Use (Legal approval required)
- GPL 2.0/3.0
- AGPL (any version)
- SSPL
- Unknown/No license

---

## Before Adding a Dependency

### Step 1: Check the License

```bash
# npm
npm view <package> license

# pip  
pip show <package> | grep License

# cargo
cargo search <crate> --limit 1
```

### Step 2: Verify Against Policy

```bash
# Run our license checker
./scripts/check-license.sh <package>
```

### Step 3: If Restricted/Unknown

1. Search for alternatives: https://alternativeto.net
2. If no alternative, submit exception request
3. Do not merge until approved

---

## Adding Attribution

When using any open-source component:

1. **Add to THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt:**
   ```
   Component: <name>
   Version: <version>
   License: <license>
   Copyright: <copyright holder>
   ```

2. **Copy license file:**
   ```bash
   cp node_modules/<pkg>/LICENSE licenses/<pkg>-LICENSE
   ```

3. **Update SBOM:**
   ```bash
   npm run generate-sbom
   ```

---

## Common Scenarios

### Scenario: Need a GPL library for development only

**Answer:** Generally OK if:
- Not distributed to users
- Not included in shipped product
- Used only for testing/development

**Example:** Using GPL test framework
```json
{
  "devDependencies": {
    "gpl-test-tool": "^1.0.0"  // OK - dev only
  }
}
```

### Scenario: Want to use LGPL library

**Answer:** OK with dynamic linking:
```javascript
// ✅ Good - dynamic import
const lgplLib = await import('lgpl-library');

// ❌ Bad - static bundling without provisions
import lgplLib from 'lgpl-library';  // Review needed
```

### Scenario: Found component with no license

**Answer:** 
1. Do not use
2. Contact author: "Could you add a LICENSE file?"
3. Find alternative

### Scenario: License changed in new version

**Answer:**
1. Document in CHANGELOG
2. Evaluate new license
3. Pin to old version if new is problematic
4. Plan migration to alternative if needed

---

## CI/CD Integration

Our pipeline automatically:
1. ✅ Scans all dependencies
2. ✅ Blocks prohibited licenses
3. ✅ Warns on restricted licenses
4. ✅ Generates SBOM artifacts

### If Build Fails for License

```bash
# View the violation
cat license-report.json | jq '.violations'

# Options:
# 1. Remove the dependency
# 2. Find alternative
# 3. Request exception (if justified)
```

- **Slack:** #opensource-compliance
- **Email:** opensource-legal@example.com
- **Wiki:** https://wiki.example.com/opensource
- **Exception form:** https://forms.example.com/license-exception

# 1. Executive Summary & Core Principles

## 1.1 Mission Statement

To optimize antimicrobial use, improve patient outcomes, reduce antimicrobial resistance, minimize adverse events, and decrease healthcare costs through systematic, evidence-based interventions.

```

│  RIGHT DOSE      →  PK-PD optimized for site/severity          │
│  RIGHT ROUTE     →  IV only when necessary                     │
│  RIGHT DURATION  →  Evidence-based, shortest effective         │
│  RIGHT TIME      →  De-escalate when data available            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

# 3. Formulary Strategy

## 3.1 Formulary Restriction Framework

### Tiered Restriction Model

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   FORMULARY TIER SYSTEM                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                 │
│  TIER 1: UNRESTRICTED                                          │
│  ├── First-line agents for common infections                   │
│  ├── Narrow spectrum preferred                                 │
│  └── Examples: Cefazolin, ampicillin, metronidazole           │
│                                                                 │
│  TIER 2: GUIDED (Clinical Decision Support)                    │
│  ├── Appropriate use criteria in order entry                   │
│  ├── Auto-populated indications                                │
│  └── Examples: Fluoroquinolones, azithromycin                  │
│                                                                 │
│  TIER 3: RESTRICTED (Prior Authorization Required)             │
│  ├── ID/ASP approval within 24-48 hours                        │
│  ├── First dose available, then requires approval              │
│  └── Examples: Carbapenems, daptomycin, linezolid             │
│                                                                 │
│  TIER 4: HIGHLY RESTRICTED (Mandatory ID Consult)              │
│  ├── Cannot order without active ID consultation               │
│  ├── Specialty agents for MDR organisms                        │
│  └── Examples: Ceftazidime-avibactam, cefiderocol             │
│                                                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 4.2 Blood Culture Optimization

### Indication Criteria

```
BLOOD CULTURE ORDERING CRITERIA

APPROPRIATE INDICATIONS:
□ Temperature ≥38.3°C (101°F) or <36°C (96.8°F)
□ New or worsening hemodynamic instability
□ New unexplained mental status change
□ Risk for endovascular infection
□ Immunocompromised with fever
□ Suspected bacteremia source (line infection, abscess)

RELATIVE INDICATIONS (Clinical judgment):
○ Temperature 38.0-38.2°C in high-risk patient
○ Unexplained leukocytosis with clinical concern
○ Pre-antimicrobial initiation for serious infection

AVOID ORDERING:
✗ Routine daily cultures without clinical change
✗ Low-grade fever post-operative (first 48h)
✗ Temperature from non-infectious cause
✗ Isolated leukocytosis without symptoms
✗ "Pan-culture" without clinical indication
```

### Collection Best Practices

| Parameter | Standard | Rationale |
|-----------|----------|-----------|
| **Volume** | 20-30 mL/set (adults) | Every mL increases yield 3% |
| **Sets** | 2-4 sets from separate sites | Distinguishes contaminant vs pathogen |
| **Timing** | Before antimicrobials if possible | Antimicrobials reduce yield |
| **Site preparation** | Chlorhexidine > povidone-iodine | Lower contamination rate |
| **Through lines** | Paired peripheral + central | Assess line infection |

│  TARGET: AUC24/MIC 400-600 (for MRSA with MIC ≤1 mcg/mL)       │
│                                                                 │
│  METHOD OPTIONS:                                               │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 1. BAYESIAN SOFTWARE (Preferred)                        │   │
│  │    • Examples: PrecisePK, DoseMeRx, InsightRx           │   │
│  │    • Requires 1-2 levels (trough + peak ideal)          │   │
│  │    • Real-time AUC estimation                           │   │
│  │    • Dose optimization recommendations                  │   │
│  │                                                         │   │
│  │ 2. TWO-LEVEL EQUATION (First-order kinetics)           │   │
│  │    • Peak (1-2h post-infusion) + Trough (within 30min)  │   │
│  │    • Calculate AUC using trapezoidal method or          │   │
│  │      one-compartment equations                          │   │
│  │                                                         │   │
│  │ 3. STEADY-STATE TROUGH ESTIMATION (less accurate)       │   │
│  │    • If AUC not feasible                               │   │
│  │    • Target trough: 15-20 mg/L (correlates AUC 400-600)│   │
│  │    • Higher nephrotoxicity risk, less reliable          │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                 │
│  WORKFLOW:                                                     │
│                                                                 │
│  Initial Dosing:                                               │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 1. Loading dose: 25-30 mg/kg (actual body weight)       │   │
│  │    Max: 3g (round to nearest 250mg)                     │   │
│  │                                                         │   │
│  │ 2. Maintenance: 15-20 mg/kg q8-12h                      │   │
│  │    Obese (BMI >30): Use adjusted body weight            │   │
│  │    ABW = IBW + 0.4(TBW - IBW)                          │   │
│  │                                                         │   │
│  │ 3. Renal adjustment:                                    │   │
│  │    CrCl >90: q8h                                       │   │
│  │    CrCl 50-90: q12h                                    │   │
│  │    CrCl 30-50: q24h                                    │   │
│  │    CrCl <30: Per levels                                │   │
│  │    Hemodialysis: Per protocol                          │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                 │
│  Monitoring:                                                   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ • Draw first trough before 4th dose (steady state)      │   │
│  │ • If Bayesian: Can draw earlier (2 doses)               │   │
│  │ • Repeat levels: 2-3x weekly or with renal changes      │   │
│  │ • Obtain levels more frequently if:                     │   │
│  │   - Critically ill/hemodynamically unstable             │   │
│  │   - Rapidly changing renal function                     │   │
│  │   - Concomitant nephrotoxins                           │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                 │
│  AUC INTERPRETATION:                                           │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  AUC <400     →  Increase dose (risk of failure)        │   │
│  │  AUC 400-600  →  Optimal (continue current regimen)     │   │
│  │  AUC 600-700  →  Acceptable, monitor closely            │   │
│  │  AUC >700     →  Reduce dose (nephrotoxicity risk ↑)    │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 7.2 IV-to-Oral Conversion

### Eligibility Criteria

```
IV-TO-ORAL CONVERSION ELIGIBILITY

PATIENT CRITERIA (All must be met):
□ Afebrile for ≥24 hours (T <38°C)
□ Hemodynamically stable (no vasopressors)
□ Tolerating oral intake
□ Adequate GI absorption expected
□ Not NPO for procedure in next 24h
□ Clinical improvement observed

INFECTION CRITERIA:
□ Source controlled
□ No endovascular infection (endocarditis, septic thrombus)
□ No CNS infection (meningitis, abscess) - unless specific oral agents
□ No severe deep-seated infection (osteomyelitis - assess case by case)
□ No neutropenia with active infection

AGENT AVAILABILITY:
□ Oral agent with adequate bioavailability
□ Organism susceptible to oral option
□ Appropriate dosing achievable orally
```

### High-Bioavailability Oral Agents

| Drug | Bioavailability | Preferred Indications |
|------|-----------------|----------------------|
| **Fluoroquinolones** | >80-95% | UTI, respiratory, bone |
| **Metronidazole** | ~100% | Anaerobic, C. diff |
| **Linezolid** | ~100% | MRSA, VRE |
| **TMP-SMX** | >90% | UTI, SSTI, PJP |
| **Doxycycline** | >90% | Respiratory, SSTI |
| **Fluconazole** | >90% | Candida infections |
| **Clindamycin** | ~90% | SSTI, anaerobic |
| **Voriconazole** | >90% | Aspergillosis (step-down) |

### Oral Step-Down Table by Organism

| IV Agent | Oral Step-Down | Comments |
|----------|----------------|----------|
| Ceftriaxone | Cefdinir, Cefpodoxime, Amox-clav | Lower bioavailability oral cephalosporins |
| Amp-sulbactam | Amoxicillin-clavulanate | Good step-down |
| Pip-tazo | Amoxicillin-clavulanate, FQ | If susceptible |
| Vancomycin | Linezolid, Doxycycline, TMP-SMX | Depends on site/organism |
| Fluconazole IV | Fluconazole PO | Same drug, same dose |
| Metronidazole IV | Metronidazole PO | Same drug, same dose |
| Ertapenem | Ertapenem (OPAT) or FQ | OPAT if no oral option |

## 7.3 Duration of Therapy Guidelines

### Evidence-Based Short Durations

| Infection | Traditional | Evidence-Based | Key Trial/Guideline |
|-----------|-------------|----------------|---------------------|
| **CAP** | 7-10 days | 5 days (if stable) | IDSA 2019, multiple RCTs |
| **HAP/VAP** | 14-21 days | 7 days | IDSA 2016 |
| **Uncomplicated UTI** | 7 days | 3-5 days | Varies by agent |
| **Pyelonephritis** | 14 days | 5-7 days (FQ) | IDSA 2010 |
| **Intra-abdominal** | 7-14 days | 4 days (with source control) | STOP-IT trial |
| **SSTI (cellulitis)** | 10-14 days | 5-6 days | Hepburn 2004 |
| **GNR bacteremia** | 14 days | 7 days (uncomplicated) | Yahav 2017 |
| **Enterococcal UTI** | 7-14 days | 5-7 days | Clinical judgment |

## 9.3 NHSN Antimicrobial Use Reporting

### SAAR Calculations

```
STANDARDIZED ANTIMICROBIAL ADMINISTRATION RATIO (SAAR)

Definition: Observed antimicrobial use ÷ Expected use (risk-adjusted)

SAAR = 1.0 → Using as expected for patient population
SAAR < 1.0 → Using LESS than expected (potential conservation)
SAAR > 1.0 → Using MORE than expected (may need intervention)

NHSN SAAR AGENT CATEGORIES:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Category                    │ Included Agents                  │
├─────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────│
│ Broad-Spectrum Hospital-    │ Pip-tazo, carbapenems,          │
│ Onset (BSHO)                │ ceftazidime, cefepime           │
│                             │                                  │
│ Broad-Spectrum Community-   │ 3rd gen cephalosporins,         │
│ Onset (BSCO)                │ fluoroquinolones                │
│                             │                                  │
│ Anti-MRSA                   │ Vancomycin, daptomycin,         │
│                             │ linezolid, ceftaroline          │
│                             │                                  │
│ CDI-Implicated              │ FQ, clindamycin, cephalosporins,│
│                             │ carbapenems                      │
│                             │                                  │
│ All Antibacterials          │ All systemically administered   │
│                             │ antibacterial agents            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

USING SAAR DATA:
• Compare your facility to NHSN benchmarks
• Track trends over time (is SAAR improving?)
• Identify specific agent categories for intervention
• Set institutional goals (e.g., BSHO SAAR <0.9)
```

## 1. What is PCA?

PCA transforms correlated variables into a smaller set of **uncorrelated** components that capture maximum variance.

```
Original Variables (correlated)          Principal Components (uncorrelated)
        ┌─────────┐                              ┌─────────┐
    X₁ ─┤         │                         PC₁ ─┤ 70% var │ ← Most important
    X₂ ─┤  Data   │───── PCA Transform ────►PC₂ ─┤ 20% var │
    X₃ ─┤         │                         PC₃ ─┤ 10% var │ ← Least important
        └─────────┘                              └─────────┘
     p dimensions                             p dimensions
                                          (but ranked by importance)
```

```
         Features (p variables)
         ┌─────────────────────┐
         │  X₁    X₂   ...  Xₚ │
    ─────┼─────────────────────┤
    n    │  2     3        5   │  ← observation 1
    obs  │  4     6        7   │  ← observation 2
    ↓    │  ...                │
         │  8     9        12  │  ← observation n
         └─────────────────────┘
         
Data matrix X is n × p
