### Faceted Navigation Handler

```python
# faceted_navigation_handler.py
from typing import List, Dict, Set, Optional, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs, urlencode
from enum import Enum
import re
import hashlib

class FacetStrategy(Enum):
    INDEX_CRAWL = "index_crawl"           # Full indexing
    NOINDEX_FOLLOW = "noindex_follow"     # No index, but follow links
    NOINDEX_NOFOLLOW = "noindex_nofollow" # Block completely
    CANONICALIZE = "canonicalize"         # Point to canonical version
    BLOCK_ROBOTS = "block_robots"         # Block in robots.txt

@dataclass
class FacetConfig:
    """Configuration for a single facet type."""
    name: str
    parameter: str
    strategy: FacetStrategy
    allowed_values: Optional[Set[str]] = None
    max_selections: int = 1
    has_search_demand: bool = False
    creates_unique_content: bool = False

@dataclass
class FacetedURL:
    """Represents a faceted URL with analysis."""
    original_url: str
    base_url: str
    facets: Dict[str, List[str]]
    strategy: FacetStrategy
    canonical_url: Optional[str] = None
    meta_robots: Optional[str] = None
    should_crawl: bool = True
    should_index: bool = True

class FacetedNavigationHandler:
    """Handle faceted navigation for crawl budget optimization."""
    
    def __init__(self, domain: str):
        self.domain = domain
        self.facet_configs: Dict[str, FacetConfig] = {}
        self.allowed_combinations: List[Tuple[str, ...]] = []
        self.blocked_combinations: List[Tuple[str, ...]] = []
        
    def register_facet(self, config: FacetConfig):
        """Register a facet configuration."""
        self.facet_configs[config.parameter] = config
        return self
    
    def allow_combination(self, *facet_names: str):
        """Allow a specific combination of facets to be indexed."""
        self.allowed_combinations.append(tuple(sorted(facet_names)))
        return self
    
    def block_combination(self, *facet_names: str):
        """Block a specific combination of facets."""
        self.blocked_combinations.append(tuple(sorted(facet_names)))
        return self
    
    def analyze_url(self, url: str) -> FacetedURL:
        """Analyze a URL and determine its handling strategy."""
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        base_url = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}{parsed.path}"
        query_params = parse_qs(parsed.query)
        
        # Identify facets in the URL
        facets = {}
        non_facet_params = {}
        
        for param, values in query_params.items():
            if param in self.facet_configs:
                facets[param] = values
            else:
                non_facet_params[param] = values
        
        # Determine strategy
        strategy = self._determine_strategy(facets)
        
        # Build result
        result = FacetedURL(
            original_url=url,
            base_url=base_url,
            facets=facets,
            strategy=strategy
        )
        
        # Set canonical URL
        if strategy in [FacetStrategy.CANONICALIZE, FacetStrategy.NOINDEX_FOLLOW]:
            result.canonical_url = self._build_canonical(base_url, facets)
        
        # Set meta robots
        result.meta_robots = self._get_meta_robots(strategy)
        
        # Set crawl/index flags
        result.should_crawl = strategy not in [FacetStrategy.BLOCK_ROBOTS]
        result.should_index = strategy == FacetStrategy.INDEX_CRAWL
        
        return result
    
    def _determine_strategy(self, facets: Dict[str, List[str]]) -> FacetStrategy:
        """Determine the best strategy for a combination of facets."""
        if not facets:
            return FacetStrategy.INDEX_CRAWL
        
        facet_names = tuple(sorted(facets.keys()))
        
        # Check if combination is explicitly blocked
        if facet_names in self.blocked_combinations:
            return FacetStrategy.BLOCK_ROBOTS
        
        # Check if combination is explicitly allowed
        if facet_names in self.allowed_combinations:
            return FacetStrategy.INDEX_CRAWL
        
        # Check individual facet configs
        all_indexable = True
        any_high_value = False
        total_selections = 0
        
        for param, values in facets.items():
            config = self.facet_configs.get(param)
            if not config:
                # Unknown facet - be conservative
                return FacetStrategy.NOINDEX_NOFOLLOW
            
            total_selections += len(values)
            
            if config.has_search_demand and config.creates_unique_content:
                any_high_value = True
            
            if len(values) > config.max_selections:
                all_indexable = False
            
            if config.allowed_values:
                if not all(v in config.allowed_values for v in values):
                    all_indexable = False
        
        # Decision logic
        if len(facets) == 1 and any_high_value and all_indexable:
            return FacetStrategy.INDEX_CRAWL
        
        if len(facets) <= 2 and all_indexable:
            return FacetStrategy.CANONICALIZE
        
        if total_selections > 3:
            return FacetStrategy.BLOCK_ROBOTS
        
        return FacetStrategy.NOINDEX_FOLLOW
    
    def _build_canonical(self, base_url: str, 
                         facets: Dict[str, List[str]]) -> str:
        """Build canonical URL for faceted page."""
        # Find the most valuable single facet
        best_facet = None
        best_priority = -1
        
        priority_order = ['category', 'brand', 'type', 'style']
        
        for param in facets.keys():
            if param in priority_order:
                priority = len(priority_order) - priority_order.index(param)
                if priority > best_priority:
                    best_priority = priority
                    best_facet = param
        
        if best_facet:
            return f"{base_url}?{best_facet}={facets[best_facet][0]}"
        
        return base_url
    
    def _get_meta_robots(self, strategy: FacetStrategy) -> str:
        """Get the meta robots directive for a strategy."""
        directives = {
            FacetStrategy.INDEX_CRAWL: "index, follow",
            FacetStrategy.NOINDEX_FOLLOW: "noindex, follow",
            FacetStrategy.NOINDEX_NOFOLLOW: "noindex, nofollow",
            FacetStrategy.CANONICALIZE: "index, follow",
            FacetStrategy.BLOCK_ROBOTS: None  # Handled in robots.txt
        }
        return directives.get(strategy)
    
    def generate_robots_rules(self) -> List[str]:
        """Generate robots.txt rules for blocked facets."""
        rules = []
        
        for param, config in self.facet_configs.items():
            if config.strategy == FacetStrategy.BLOCK_ROBOTS:
                rules.append(f"Disallow: /*?*{param}=")
        
        # Block complex combinations
        rules.append("# Block multiple facets")
        rules.append("Disallow: /*?*=*&*=*&*=*")  # 3+ parameters
        
        return rules
    
    def generate_html_head(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Generate HTML head elements for a faceted URL."""
        analysis = self.analyze_url(url)
        
        elements = []
        
        if analysis.meta_robots:
            elements.append(
                f'<meta name="robots" content="{analysis.meta_robots}">'
            )
        
        if analysis.canonical_url:
            elements.append(
                f'<link rel="canonical" href="{analysis.canonical_url}">'
            )
        
        return "\n".join(elements)
```

```python
# canonical_handler.py
from typing import Optional, List, Dict
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs, urlencode, urlunparse
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
import re

class CanonicalIssueType(Enum):
    MISSING = "missing_canonical"
    SELF_REFERENCING = "self_referencing"
    CROSS_DOMAIN = "cross_domain"
    CHAIN = "canonical_chain"
    CONFLICT_NOINDEX = "conflict_with_noindex"
    CONFLICT_SITEMAP = "conflict_with_sitemap"
    HTTP_HTTPS = "http_https_mismatch"
    WWW_NON_WWW = "www_non_www_mismatch"
    TRAILING_SLASH = "trailing_slash_mismatch"
    PARAMETER_HANDLING = "parameter_handling"
    PAGINATION = "pagination_canonical"

@dataclass
class CanonicalAnalysis:
    url: str
    canonical_url: Optional[str]
    issues: List[CanonicalIssueType]
    recommendation: str
    html_output: str

class CanonicalHandler:
    """Comprehensive canonical URL handler."""
    
    # Parameters that should be stripped
    STRIP_PARAMETERS = {
        'utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content',
        'fbclid', 'gclid', 'ref', 'source', 'session_id', 'sid',
        'affiliate', 'partner', 'tracking', 'click_id'
    }
    
    # Parameters that affect content (keep these)
    CONTENT_PARAMETERS = {
        'id', 'sku', 'product', 'category', 'variant', 'lang', 'locale'
    }
    
    def __init__(self, preferred_domain: str, use_https: bool = True, 
                 use_www: bool = True, use_trailing_slash: bool = False):
        self.preferred_domain = preferred_domain
        self.use_https = use_https
        self.use_www = use_www
        self.use_trailing_slash = use_trailing_slash
        
        # Custom parameter rules
        self.indexable_params: Dict[str, set] = {}
        
    def add_indexable_parameter(self, param: str, 
                                allowed_values: Optional[set] = None):
        """Mark a parameter as indexable."""
        self.indexable_params[param] = allowed_values
        return self
    
    def normalize_url(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Normalize a URL to its canonical form."""
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        
        # Normalize scheme
        scheme = 'https' if self.use_https else 'http'
        
        # Normalize domain
        netloc = parsed.netloc.lower()
        if self.use_www and not netloc.startswith('www.'):
            netloc = f'www.{netloc}'
        elif not self.use_www and netloc.startswith('www.'):
            netloc = netloc[4:]
        
        # Normalize path
        path = parsed.path
        if not path:
            path = '/'
        
        # Handle trailing slash
        if path != '/':
            if self.use_trailing_slash and not path.endswith('/'):
                path = f'{path}/'
            elif not self.use_trailing_slash and path.endswith('/'):
                path = path.rstrip('/')
        
        # Normalize parameters
        query_params = parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)
        normalized_params = {}
        
        for param, values in sorted(query_params.items()):
            # Strip tracking parameters
            if param.lower() in self.STRIP_PARAMETERS:
                continue
            
            # Keep content parameters
            if param.lower() in self.CONTENT_PARAMETERS:
                normalized_params[param] = values
                continue
            
            # Check custom rules
            if param in self.indexable_params:
                allowed = self.indexable_params[param]
                if allowed is None:  # All values allowed
                    normalized_params[param] = values
                else:
                    filtered = [v for v in values if v in allowed]
                    if filtered:
                        normalized_params[param] = filtered
        
        # Rebuild query string
        query = urlencode(normalized_params, doseq=True) if normalized_params else ''
        
        # Rebuild URL
        normalized = urlunparse((
            scheme,
            netloc,
            path,
            '',  # params
            query,
            ''   # fragment
        ))
        
        return normalized
    
    def analyze_canonical(self, page_url: str, 
                         declared_canonical: Optional[str] = None,
                         page_in_sitemap: bool = False,
                         has_noindex: bool = False) -> CanonicalAnalysis:
        """Analyze canonical implementation for a page."""
        issues = []
        
        normalized_page = self.normalize_url(page_url)
        
        # Check for missing canonical
        if not declared_canonical:
            issues.append(CanonicalIssueType.MISSING)
        else:
            normalized_canonical = self.normalize_url(declared_canonical)
            
            # Check for various issues
            if normalized_canonical == normalized_page:
                # Self-referencing is generally fine
                pass
            else:
                # Check for HTTP/HTTPS mismatch
                if urlparse(declared_canonical).scheme != urlparse(normalized_page).scheme:
                    issues.append(CanonicalIssueType.HTTP_HTTPS)
                
                # Check for www mismatch
                page_has_www = 'www.' in urlparse(page_url).netloc
                canonical_has_www = 'www.' in urlparse(declared_canonical).netloc
                if page_has_www != canonical_has_www:
                    issues.append(CanonicalIssueType.WWW_NON_WWW)
                
                # Check for cross-domain
                if urlparse(declared_canonical).netloc != urlparse(page_url).netloc:
                    issues.append(CanonicalIssueType.CROSS_DOMAIN)
            
            # Check for conflicts
            if has_noindex and declared_canonical != page_url:
                issues.append(CanonicalIssueType.CONFLICT_NOINDEX)
            
            if page_in_sitemap and declared_canonical != page_url:
                issues.append(CanonicalIssueType.CONFLICT_SITEMAP)
        
        # Generate recommendation
        recommendation = self._generate_recommendation(issues, normalized_page)
        
        # Generate HTML
        html_output = self._generate_html(normalized_page, issues)
        
        return CanonicalAnalysis(
            url=page_url,
            canonical_url=normalized_page,
            issues=issues,
            recommendation=recommendation,
            html_output=html_output
        )
    
    def _generate_recommendation(self, issues: List[CanonicalIssueType], 
                                  canonical: str) -> str:
        """Generate a recommendation based on issues found."""
        if not issues:
            return f"✓ Canonical implementation is correct. Use: {canonical}"
        
        recommendations = []
        
        if CanonicalIssueType.MISSING in issues:
            recommendations.append(f"Add canonical tag pointing to: {canonical}")
        
        if CanonicalIssueType.CONFLICT_NOINDEX in issues:
            recommendations.append(
                "Remove noindex OR set canonical to self. "
                "These directives conflict."
            )
        
        if CanonicalIssueType.CONFLICT_SITEMAP in issues:
            recommendations.append(
                "Only include canonical URLs in sitemap, or update canonical to self."
            )
        
        if CanonicalIssueType.HTTP_HTTPS in issues:
            recommendations.append("Ensure canonical uses HTTPS.")
        
        if CanonicalIssueType.WWW_NON_WWW in issues:
            recommendations.append(
                "Ensure consistent www/non-www in canonical."
            )
        
        return " | ".join(recommendations)
    
    def _generate_html(self, canonical: str, 
                       issues: List[CanonicalIssueType]) -> str:
        """Generate proper HTML canonical element."""
        return f'<link rel="canonical" href="{canonical}">'
    
    def generate_redirect_rules(self, urls: List[str]) -> str:
        """Generate redirect rules for URL normalization."""
        rules = []
        rules.append("# URL Canonicalization Redirects")
        rules.append("")
        
        # HTTPS redirect
        if self.use_https:
            rules.append("# Force HTTPS")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off")
            rules.append("RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]")
            rules.append("")
        
        # WWW redirect
        if self.use_www:
            rules.append("# Force WWW")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^www\\.")
            rules.append("RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://www.%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]")
        else:
            rules.append("# Remove WWW")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\\.(.*)$ [NC]")
            rules.append("RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%1%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]")
        rules.append("")
        
        # Trailing slash handling
        if self.use_trailing_slash:
            rules.append("# Add trailing slash")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !/$")
            rules.append("RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/$1/ [L,R=301]")
        else:
            rules.append("# Remove trailing slash")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d")
            rules.append("RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} (.+)/$")
            rules.append("RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/$1 [L,R=301]")
        
        return "\n".join(rules)


# Example usage
handler = CanonicalHandler(
    preferred_domain="example.com",
    use_https=True,
    use_www=True,
    use_trailing_slash=False
)

# Add indexable parameters
handler.add_indexable_parameter("category")
handler.add_indexable_parameter("brand")

# Test URLs
test_cases = [
    ("http://example.com/product?utm_source=google", None, False, False),
    ("https://www.example.com/product", "https://www.example.com/product", True, False),
    ("https://www.example.com/product", "http://example.com/product", False, False),
    ("https://www.example.com/product/", None, False, True),  # has noindex
]

print("Canonical Analysis Results:")
print("=" * 80)

for url, canonical, in_sitemap, has_noindex in test_cases:
    analysis = handler.analyze_canonical(url, canonical, in_sitemap, has_noindex)
    print(f"\nURL: {url}")
    print(f"  Declared Canonical: {canonical}")
    print(f"  Recommended Canonical: {analysis.canonical_url}")
    print(f"  Issues: {[i.value for i in analysis.issues]}")
    print(f"  Recommendation: {analysis.recommendation}")
    print(f"  HTML: {analysis.html_output}")
```

```python
# pagination_handler.py
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import ceil
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urlparse, parse_qs

@dataclass
class PaginationConfig:
    items_per_page: int = 24
    max_pages: int = 100
    use_rel_links: bool = True  # rel="prev/next" (deprecated but still used)
    use_view_all: bool = False
    use_infinite_scroll: bool = False
    canonicalize_to_first: bool = False
    
@dataclass
class PaginatedPage:
    url: str
    page_number: int
    total_pages: int
    canonical_url: str
    prev_url: Optional[str]
    next_url: Optional[str]
    meta_robots: str
    should_index: bool
    html_head: str

class PaginationHandler:
    """Handle pagination for optimal crawl budget usage."""
    
    def __init__(self, base_url: str, config: PaginationConfig = None):
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip('/')
        self.config = config or PaginationConfig()
        
    def generate_page_url(self, page: int, base_url: str = None) -> str:
        """Generate URL for a specific page number."""
        url = base_url or self.base_url
        
        if page == 1:
            return url
        
        # Parse existing URL
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        params = parse_qs(parsed.query)
        params['page'] = [str(page)]
        
        query = urlencode(params, doseq=True)
        return f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}{parsed.path}?{query}"
    
    def analyze_page(self, current_url: str, page_number: int, 
                     total_items: int) -> PaginatedPage:
        """Analyze a paginated page and generate recommendations."""
        total_pages = ceil(total_items / self.config.items_per_page)
        
        # Limit to max pages
        total_pages = min(total_pages, self.config.max_pages)
        
        # Determine canonical
        if self.config.canonicalize_to_first and page_number > 1:
            canonical_url = self.generate_page_url(1)
            should_index = False
        else:
            canonical_url = current_url
            should_index = page_number <= 50  # Index first 50 pages
        
        # Generate prev/next
        prev_url = None
        next_url = None
        
        if page_number > 1:
            prev_url = self.generate_page_url(page_number - 1)
        
        if page_number < total_pages:
            next_url = self.generate_page_url(page_number + 1)
        
        # Meta robots
        if page_number > 50:  # Deep pagination
            meta_robots = "noindex, follow"
            should_index = False
        else:
            meta_robots = "index, follow"
        
        # Generate HTML head
        html_head = self._generate_html_head(
            canonical_url, prev_url, next_url, 
            page_number, total_pages, should_index
        )
        
        return PaginatedPage(
            url=current_url,
            page_number=page_number,
            total_pages=total_pages,
            canonical_url=canonical_url,
            prev_url=prev_url,
            next_url=next_url,
            meta_robots=meta_robots,
            should_index=should_index,
            html_head=html_head
        )
    
    def _generate_html_head(self, canonical: str, prev_url: Optional[str],
                            next_url: Optional[str], page_number: int,
                            total_pages: int, should_index: bool) -> str:
        """Generate complete HTML head elements for pagination."""
        elements = []
        
        # Canonical
        elements.append(f'<link rel="canonical" href="{canonical}">')
        
        # Rel prev/next (still useful for some crawlers)
        if prev_url:
            elements.append(f'<link rel="prev" href="{prev_url}">')
        if next_url:
            elements.append(f'<link rel="next" href="{next_url}">')
        
        # Meta robots for deep pages
        if not should_index:
            elements.append('<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">')
        
        # Title optimization
        if page_number > 1:
            elements.append(f"<!-- Add ' - Page {page_number}' to title -->")
        
        return "\n".join(elements)
    
    def get_sitemap_urls(self, total_items: int, 
                         include_all_pages: bool = False) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
        """Get URLs to include in sitemap with priorities."""
        total_pages = ceil(total_items / self.config.items_per_page)
        total_pages = min(total_pages, self.config.max_pages)
        
        urls = []
        
        # First page gets highest priority
        urls.append((self.generate_page_url(1), 0.8))
        
        if include_all_pages:
            for page in range(2, total_pages + 1):
                # Decreasing priority for deeper pages
                priority = max(0.3, 0.7 - (page * 0.01))
                urls.append((self.generate_page_url(page), priority))
        else:
            # Only include first 5 pages
            for page in range(2, min(6, total_pages + 1)):
                priority = max(0.4, 0.7 - (page * 0.05))
                urls.append((self.generate_page_url(page), priority))
        
        return urls
    
    def generate_smart_pagination_links(self, current_page: int, 
                                        total_pages: int) -> List[dict]:
        """Generate smart pagination links that aid crawling."""
        links = []
        
        # Always show first page
        links.append({'page': 1, 'label': '1', 'type': 'first'})
        
        # Show pages around current
        start = max(2, current_page - 2)
        end = min(total_pages - 1, current_page + 2)
        
        if start > 2:
            links.append({'page': None, 'label': '...', 'type': 'ellipsis'})
        
        for page in range(start, end + 1):
            page_type = 'current' if page == current_page else 'normal'
            links.append({'page': page, 'label': str(page), 'type': page_type})
        
        if end < total_pages - 1:
            links.append({'page': None, 'label': '...', 'type': 'ellipsis'})
        
        # Always show last page
        if total_pages > 1:
            links.append({
                'page': total_pages, 
                'label': str(total_pages), 
                'type': 'last'
            })
        
        return links


# Example usage
handler = PaginationHandler(
    "https://store.example.com/category/shoes",
    PaginationConfig(
        items_per_page=24,
        max_pages=100,
        use_rel_links=True,
        canonicalize_to_first=False
    )
)

# Analyze a specific page

    current_page,
    total_items
)

print("=" * 60)
print(f"URL: {result.url}")
print(f"Page: {result.page_number} of {result.total_pages}")
print(f"Should Index: {result.should_index}")
print(f"Meta Robots: {result.meta_robots}")
print(f"\nHTML Head Elements:")
print(result.html_head)

print(f"\nSitemap URLs:")
for url, priority in handler.get_sitemap_urls(total_items):
    print(f"  {url} (priority: {priority})")

print(f"\nPagination Links for page {current_page}:")
for link in handler.generate_smart_pagination_links(current_page, result.total_pages):
    print(f"  {link}")
```

## 6. Duplicate Content Detection & Resolution

```python
# duplicate_content_detector.py
import hashlib
from typing import List, Dict, Set, Optional, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from collections import defaultdict
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse

@dataclass
class ContentFingerprint:
    url: str
    title_hash: str
    body_hash: str
    content_hash: str
    word_count: int
    significant_text: str
    similarity_group: Optional[int] = None

@dataclass
class DuplicateGroup:
    canonical_url: str
    duplicate_urls: List[str]
    similarity_score: float
    duplicate_type: str  # exact, near, thin
    resolution: str
    
class DuplicateContentDetector:
    """Detect and resolve duplicate content issues."""
    
    SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.85  # 85% similar = duplicate
    THIN_CONTENT_WORDS = 300
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.fingerprints: Dict[str, ContentFingerprint] = {}
        self.content_hashes: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.duplicate_groups: List[DuplicateGroup] = []
        
    def _normalize_text(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Normalize text for comparison."""
        # Remove extra whitespace
        text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
        # Remove common boilerplate patterns
        text = re.sub(r'©.*?\d{4}', '', text)
        text = re.sub(r'All rights reserved\.?', '', text, flags=re.I)
        # Remove numbers that might vary (prices, dates)
        text = re.sub(r'\$[\d,]+\.?\d*', '[PRICE]', text)
        text = re.sub(r'\b\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}\b', '[DATE]', text)
        return text.strip().lower()
    
    def _extract_significant_text(self, html: str) -> str:
        """Extract significant content from HTML."""
        # Remove script and style
        text = re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', html, flags=re.S)
        text = re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>', '', text, flags=re.S)
        # Remove common navigation patterns
        text = re.sub(r'<nav[^>]*>.*?</nav>', '', text, flags=re.S)
        text = re.sub(r'<header[^>]*>.*?</header>', '', text, flags=re.S)
        text = re.sub(r'<footer[^>]*>.*?</footer>', '', text, flags=re.S)
        # Remove tags
        text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)
        # Normalize
        return self._normalize_text(text)
    
    def _hash_content(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Create hash of content."""
        return hashlib.md5(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    
    def add_page(self, url: str, title: str, body_html: str):
        """Add a page to the duplicate detection system."""
        significant_text = self._extract_significant_text(body_html)
        
        fingerprint = ContentFingerprint(
            url=url,
            title_hash=self._hash_content(self._normalize_text(title)),
            body_hash=self._hash_content(significant_text),
            content_hash=self._hash_content(f"{title}|{significant_text}"),
            word_count=len(significant_text.split()),
            significant_text=significant_text[:500]  # Store excerpt
        )
        
        self.fingerprints[url] = fingerprint
        self.content_hashes[fingerprint.content_hash].append(url)
        
    def calculate_similarity(self, url1: str, url2: str) -> float:
        """Calculate similarity between two pages."""
        fp1 = self.fingerprints.get(url1)
        fp2 = self.fingerprints.get(url2)
        
        if not fp1 or not fp2:
            return 0.0
        
        # Quick check for exact matches
        if fp1.content_hash == fp2.content_hash:
            return 1.0
        
        # Calculate text similarity
        return SequenceMatcher(
            None, 
            fp1.significant_text, 
            fp2.significant_text
        ).ratio()
    
    def find_duplicates(self) -> List[DuplicateGroup]:
        """Find all duplicate content groups."""
        self.duplicate_groups = []
        processed_urls: Set[str] = set()
        
        # First pass: exact duplicates by hash
        for content_hash, urls in self.content_hashes.items():
            if len(urls) > 1:
                canonical = self._select_canonical(urls)
                duplicates = [u for u in urls if u != canonical]
                
                self.duplicate_groups.append(DuplicateGroup(
                    canonical_url=canonical,
                    duplicate_urls=duplicates,
                    similarity_score=1.0,
                    duplicate_type="exact",
                    resolution=self._generate_resolution("exact", canonical, duplicates)
                ))
                processed_urls.update(urls)
        
        # Second pass: near duplicates
        urls = list(self.fingerprints.keys())
        for i, url1 in enumerate(urls):
            if url1 in processed_urls:
                continue
                
            near_duplicates = []
            for url2 in urls[i+1:]:
                if url2 in processed_urls:
                    continue
                
                similarity = self.calculate_similarity(url1, url2)
                if similarity >= self.SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD:
                    near_duplicates.append((url2, similarity))
            
            if near_duplicates:
                all_urls = [url1] + [u for u, _ in near_duplicates]
                canonical = self._select_canonical(all_urls)
                duplicates = [u for u in all_urls if u != canonical]
                avg_similarity = sum(s for _, s in near_duplicates) / len(near_duplicates)
                
                self.duplicate_groups.append(DuplicateGroup(
                    canonical_url=canonical,
                    duplicate_urls=duplicates,
                    similarity_score=avg_similarity,
                    duplicate_type="near",
                    resolution=self._generate_resolution("near", canonical, duplicates)
                ))
                processed_urls.update(all_urls)
        
        # Third pass: thin content
        for url, fp in self.fingerprints.items():
            if url in processed_urls:
                continue
            if fp.word_count < self.THIN_CONTENT_WORDS:
                self.duplicate_groups.append(DuplicateGroup(
                    canonical_url=url,
                    duplicate_urls=[],
                    similarity_score=0.0,
                    duplicate_type="thin",
                    resolution=self._generate_resolution("thin", url, [])
                ))
        
        return self.duplicate_groups
    
    def _select_canonical(self, urls: List[str]) -> str:
        """Select the best canonical URL from a group."""
        # Scoring criteria
        scores = {}
        
        for url in urls:
            score = 0
            parsed = urlparse(url)
            
            # Prefer shorter URLs
            score -= len(url) * 0.1
            
            # Prefer URLs without query parameters
            if not parsed.query:
                score += 10
            
            # Prefer URLs without fragments
            if not parsed.fragment:
                score += 5
            
            # Prefer URLs closer to root
            score -= parsed.path.count('/') * 2
            
            # Penalize URLs with certain patterns
            if 'print' in url.lower():
                score -= 20
            if 'mobile' in url.lower():
                score -= 10
            if 'amp' in url.lower():
                score -= 5
            if any(p in url.lower() for p in ['page=', 'p=', 'pg=']):
                score -= 15
            
            scores[url] = score
        
        return max(scores, key=scores.get)
    
    def _generate_resolution(self, dup_type: str, canonical: str, 
                            duplicates: List[str]) -> str:
        """Generate resolution recommendation."""
        resolutions = {
            "exact": f"""
1. Set canonical tag on all duplicates pointing to: {canonical}
2. Consider 301 redirecting duplicates to canonical
3. Update internal links to use canonical URL
4. Remove duplicates from sitemap
5. Block duplicate URL patterns in robots.txt
            """,
            
            "near": f"""
1. Set canonical tag on similar pages pointing to: {canonical}
2. Consider consolidating content if pages serve same intent
3. If unique value exists, differentiate content more
4. Add noindex to lower-value versions
            """,
            
            "thin": f"""
1. Expand content to provide more value (aim for 500+ words)
2. Consider merging with related pages
3. Add noindex if page has no search value
4. Remove from sitemap until content is expanded
            """
        }
        
        return resolutions.get(dup_type, "Manual review required")
    
    def generate_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate a comprehensive duplicate content report."""
        if not self.duplicate_groups:
            self.find_duplicates()
        
        report = []
        report.append("=" * 80)
        report.append("DUPLICATE CONTENT ANALYSIS REPORT")
        report.append("=" * 80)
        report.append("")
        
        # Summary
        exact = sum(1 for g in self.duplicate_groups if g.duplicate_type == "exact")
        near = sum(1 for g in self.duplicate_groups if g.duplicate_type == "near")
        thin = sum(1 for g in self.duplicate_groups if g.duplicate_type == "thin")
        
        report.append("SUMMARY:")
        report.append(f"  Exact duplicates: {exact} groups")
        report.append(f"  Near duplicates: {near} groups")
        report.append(f"  Thin content: {thin} pages")
        report.append("")
        
        # Details
        for i, group in enumerate(self.duplicate_groups, 1):
            report.append("-" * 60)
            report.append(f"Group {i}: {group.duplicate_type.upper()}")
            report.append(f"Similarity: {group.similarity_score:.1%}")
            report.append(f"Canonical: {group.canonical_url}")
            
            if group.duplicate_urls:
                report.append("Duplicates:")
                for url in group.duplicate_urls:
                    report.append(f"  - {url}")
            
            report.append(f"\nResolution:{group.resolution}")
            report.append("")
        
        return "\n".join(report)
```

```python
# log_file_analyzer.py
import re
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import gzip
from pathlib import Path
import json

@dataclass
class CrawlEvent:
    timestamp: datetime
    ip: str
    user_agent: str
    url: str
    status_code: int
    bytes_sent: int
    response_time: Optional[float] = None
    bot_name: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class CrawlStats:
    total_requests: int = 0
    unique_urls: int = 0
    status_codes: Dict[int, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    avg_response_time: float = 0.0
    bytes_transferred: int = 0
    crawl_rate_per_hour: float = 0.0
    url_types: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    wasted_crawl_budget: int = 0

class LogFileAnalyzer:
    """Analyze server logs for crawl budget insights."""
    
    # Bot user agent patterns
    BOT_PATTERNS = {
        'Googlebot': r'Googlebot(-Mobile|-Image|-News|-Video)?',
        'Googlebot-Mobile': r'Googlebot-Mobile',
        'Bingbot': r'bingbot',
        'Yandex': r'YandexBot',
        'Baidu': r'Baiduspider',
        'DuckDuckBot': r'DuckDuckBot',
        'Slurp': r'Slurp',
        'facebot': r'facebookexternalhit|Facebot',
        'Twitterbot': r'Twitterbot',
        'Other Bot': r'bot|crawler|spider|crawl'
    }
    
    # Common log format regex
    LOG_PATTERNS = {
        'combined': re.compile(
            r'(?P<ip>[\d.]+)\s+-\s+-\s+\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]\s+'
            r'"(?P<method>\w+)\s+(?P<url>[^\s]+)\s+[^"]+"\s+'
            r'(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+'
            r'"[^"]*"\s+"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
        ),
        'combined_with_time': re.compile(
            r'(?P<ip>[\d.]+)\s+-\s+-\s+\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]\s+'
            r'"(?P<method>\w+)\s+(?P<url>[^\s]+)\s+[^"]+"\s+'
            r'(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+'
            r'"[^"]*"\s+"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"\s+(?P<response_time>[\d.]+)'
        ),
        'nginx': re.compile(
            r'(?P<ip>[\d.]+)\s+-\s+(?P<user>[^\s]+)\s+\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]\s+'
            r'"(?P<method>\w+)\s+(?P<url>[^\s]+)\s+[^"]+"\s+'
            r'(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+'
            r'"[^"]*"\s+"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"\s*'
            r'(?:(?P<response_time>[\d.]+))?'
        )
    }
    
    # URL patterns indicating wasted crawl budget
    WASTEFUL_PATTERNS = [
        (r'\?.*utm_', 'tracking_params'),
        (r'\?.*session', 'session_params'),
        (r'\?.*sort=', 'sort_params'),
        (r'\?.*page=\d{3,}', 'deep_pagination'),
        (r'/search\?', 'internal_search'),
        (r'/filter', 'filter_pages'),
        (r'/print', 'print_pages'),
        (r'\.(pdf|doc|xls)', 'documents'),
        (r'/cart', 'cart_pages'),
        (r'/checkout', 'checkout_pages'),
        (r'/login', 'login_pages'),
        (r'/wp-admin', 'admin_pages'),
        (r'/ajax', 'ajax_endpoints'),
        (r'/api/', 'api_endpoints'),
    ]
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.events: List[CrawlEvent] = []
        self.stats_by_bot: Dict[str, CrawlStats] = defaultdict(CrawlStats)
        
    def _identify_bot(self, user_agent: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Identify bot from user agent string."""
        for bot_name, pattern in self.BOT_PATTERNS.items():
            if re.search(pattern, user_agent, re.I):
                return bot_name
        return None
    
    def _parse_timestamp(self, timestamp_str: str) -> datetime:
        """Parse log timestamp."""
        # Common format: 02/Jan/2024:10:30:45 +0000
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(
                timestamp_str.split()[0], 
                '%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S'
            )
        except ValueError:
            return datetime.now()
    
    def _categorize_url(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Categorize URL by type."""
        if re.match(r'^/$', url):
            return 'homepage'
        if re.match(r'^/category/', url):
            return 'category'
        if re.match(r'^/product/', url):
            return 'product'
        if re.match(r'^/blog/', url):
            return 'blog'
        if re.match(r'.*\.(css|js|jpg|png|gif|ico|woff)', url):
            return 'assets'
        if '?' in url:
            return 'parameterized'
        return 'other'
    
    def _is_wasteful_url(self, url: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Check if URL represents wasted crawl budget."""
        for pattern, category in self.WASTEFUL_PATTERNS:
            if re.search(pattern, url, re.I):
                return True, category
        return False, ''
    
    def parse_log_file(self, filepath: str, format_type: str = 'combined'):
        """Parse a log file and extract bot crawl events."""
        pattern = self.LOG_PATTERNS.get(format_type, self.LOG_PATTERNS['combined'])
        
        # Handle gzipped files
        if filepath.endswith('.gz'):
            opener = gzip.open
            mode = 'rt'
        else:
            opener = open
            mode = 'r'
        
        with opener(filepath, mode, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            for line in f:
                match = pattern.match(line)
                if not match:
                    continue
                
                data = match.groupdict()
                bot_name = self._identify_bot(data.get('user_agent', ''))
                
                if not bot_name:
                    continue  # Skip non-bot requests
                
                response_time = None
                if data.get('response_time'):
                    try:
                        response_time = float(data['response_time'])
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
                
                event = CrawlEvent(
                    timestamp=self._parse_timestamp(data['timestamp']),
                    ip=data['ip'],
                    user_agent=data.get('user_agent', ''),
                    url=data['url'],
                    status_code=int(data['status']),
                    bytes_sent=int(data.get('bytes', 0)),
                    response_time=response_time,
                    bot_name=bot_name
                )
                
                self.events.append(event)
    
    def analyze_crawl_patterns(self) -> Dict[str, CrawlStats]:
        """Analyze crawl patterns for each bot."""
        bot_events = defaultdict(list)
        
        for event in self.events:
            bot_events[event.bot_name].append(event)
        
        for bot_name, events in bot_events.items():
            stats = self.stats_by_bot[bot_name]
            
            stats.total_requests = len(events)
            stats.unique_urls = len(set(e.url for e in events))
            
            # Status code distribution
            for event in events:
                status_group = event.status_code
                stats.status_codes[status_group] = stats.status_codes.get(status_group, 0) + 1
            
            # Response time
            response_times = [e.response_time for e in events if e.response_time]
            if response_times:
                stats.avg_response_time = sum(response_times) / len(response_times)
            
            # Bytes transferred
            stats.bytes_transferred = sum(e.bytes_sent for e in events)
            
            # Crawl rate
            if len(events) >= 2:
                time_span = max(e.timestamp for e in events) - min(e.timestamp for e in events)
                hours = max(time_span.total_seconds() / 3600, 1)
                stats.crawl_rate_per_hour = len(events) / hours
            
            # URL types
            for event in events:
                url_type = self._categorize_url(event.url)
                stats.url_types[url_type] = stats.url_types.get(url_type, 0) + 1
            
            # Wasted crawl budget
            for event in events:
                is_wasteful, _ = self._is_wasteful_url(event.url)
                if is_wasteful:
                    stats.wasted_crawl_budget += 1
        
        return self.stats_by_bot
    
    def get_crawl_efficiency_score(self, bot_name: str = 'Googlebot') -> float:
        """Calculate crawl efficiency score (0-100)."""
        stats = self.stats_by_bot.get(bot_name)
        if not stats or stats.total_requests == 0:
            return 0.0
        
        # Factors
        wastage_ratio = stats.wasted_crawl_budget / stats.total_requests
        success_ratio = stats.status_codes.get(200, 0) / stats.total_requests
        
        # Penalize slow responses
        response_time_penalty = min(stats.avg_response_time / 5.0, 1.0) if stats.avg_response_time else 0
        
        # Calculate score
        score = (
            (1 - wastage_ratio) * 40 +      # 40 points for low wastage
            success_ratio * 40 +             # 40 points for high success rate
            (1 - response_time_penalty) * 20  # 20 points for fast responses
        )
        
        return round(score, 1)
    
    def get_wasted_urls(self, bot_name: str = 'Googlebot', limit: int = 100) -> List[Tuple[str, str, int]]:
        """Get top wasted URLs with categories."""
        wasteful_urls = defaultdict(lambda: {'count': 0, 'category': ''})
        
        for event in self.events:
            if event.bot_name != bot_name:
                continue
            
            is_wasteful, category = self._is_wasteful_url(event.url)
            if is_wasteful:
                wasteful_urls[event.url]['count'] += 1
                wasteful_urls[event.url]['category'] = category
        
        # Sort by count
        sorted_urls = sorted(
            wasteful_urls.items(),
            key=lambda x: x[1]['count'],
            reverse=True
        )[:limit]
        
        return [(url, data['category'], data['count']) for url, data in sorted_urls]
    
    def get_orphan_candidates(self, sitemap_urls: set, 
                               bot_name: str = 'Googlebot') -> List[str]:
        """Find URLs crawled but not in sitemap (potential orphans)."""
        crawled_urls = set(
            e.url for e in self.events 
            if e.bot_name == bot_name and e.status_code == 200
        )
        
        # Normalize URLs for comparison
        def normalize(url):
            return url.split('?')[0].rstrip('/')
        
        normalized_sitemap = {normalize(u) for u in sitemap_urls}
        
        orphans = []
        for url in crawled_urls:
            if normalize(url) not in normalized_sitemap:
                # Exclude assets
                if not re.search(r'\.(css|js|jpg|png|gif|ico|woff)', url):
                    orphans.append(url)
        
        return sorted(orphans)
    
    def generate_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate comprehensive crawl analysis report."""
        if not self.stats_by_bot:
            self.analyze_crawl_patterns()
        
        report = []
        report.append("=" * 80)
        report.append("CRAWL BUDGET ANALYSIS REPORT")
        report.append(f"Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
        report.append("=" * 80)
        
        for bot_name, stats in self.stats_by_bot.items():
            efficiency = self.get_crawl_efficiency_score(bot_name)
            
            report.append(f"\n{'─' * 60}")
            report.append(f"BOT: {bot_name}")
            report.append(f"Efficiency Score: {efficiency}/100")
            report.append(f"{'─' * 60}")
            
            report.append(f"\n📊 Crawl Volume:")
            report.append(f"   Total Requests: {stats.total_requests:,}")
            report.append(f"   Unique URLs: {stats.unique_urls:,}")
            report.append(f"   Crawl Rate: {stats.crawl_rate_per_hour:.1f}/hour")
            report.append(f"   Data Transferred: {stats.bytes_transferred / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB")
            
            report.append(f"\n📈 Status Codes:")
            for status, count in sorted(stats.status_codes.items()):
                pct = count / stats.total_requests * 100
                report.append(f"   {status}: {count:,} ({pct:.1f}%)")
            
            report.append(f"\n⚡ Performance:")
            report.append(f"   Avg Response Time: {stats.avg_response_time:.3f}s")
            
            report.append(f"\n📂 URL Types Crawled:")
            for url_type, count in sorted(stats.url_types.items(), 
                                          key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
                pct = count / stats.total_requests * 100
                report.append(f"   {url_type}: {count:,} ({pct:.1f}%)")
            
            report.append(f"\n⚠️ Wasted Crawl Budget:")
            wasted_pct = stats.wasted_crawl_budget / max(stats.total_requests, 1) * 100
            report.append(f"   Wasteful Requests: {stats.wasted_crawl_budget:,} ({wasted_pct:.1f}%)")
            
            # Top wasted URLs
            wasted = self.get_wasted_urls(bot_name, limit=10)
            if wasted:
                report.append(f"\n   Top Wasted URLs:")
                for url, category, count in wasted[:5]:
                    report.append(f"   - [{category}] {url[:60]}... ({count}x)")
            
            # Recommendations
            report.append(f"\n💡 Recommendations:")
            if wasted_pct > 20:
                report.append("   ⚠️  High crawl waste - update robots.txt to block wasteful patterns")
            if stats.status_codes.get(404, 0) / max(stats.total_requests, 1) > 0.05:
                report.append("   ⚠️  High 404 rate - fix broken links and update sitemap")
            if stats.status_codes.get(500, 0) / max(stats.total_requests, 1) > 0.01:
                report.append("   ⚠️  Server errors detected - investigate 5xx issues")
            if stats.avg_response_time > 2.0:
                report.append("   ⚠️  Slow response times - optimize server performance")
            if efficiency < 70:
                report.append("   ⛔ Low efficiency score - comprehensive crawl budget audit needed")
        
        return "\n".join(report)
    
    def export_to_json(self, filepath: str):
        """Export analysis to JSON."""
        if not self.stats_by_bot:
            self.analyze_crawl_patterns()
        
        data = {
            'generated': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'summary': {},
            'bots': {}
        }
        
        for bot_name, stats in self.stats_by_bot.items():
            data['bots'][bot_name] = {
                'total_requests': stats.total_requests,
                'unique_urls': stats.unique_urls,
                'status_codes': stats.status_codes,
                'avg_response_time': stats.avg_response_time,
                'bytes_transferred': stats.bytes_transferred,
                'crawl_rate_per_hour': stats.crawl_rate_per_hour,
                'url_types': stats.url_types,
                'wasted_crawl_budget': stats.wasted_crawl_budget,
                'efficiency_score': self.get_crawl_efficiency_score(bot_name),
                'wasted_urls': self.get_wasted_urls(bot_name, limit=50)
            }
        
        with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2, default=str)
```

```python
class Priority(Enum):

        )

        """Get high-impact, low-effort items."""
        return [
            item for item in self.items
            if item.effort in [Effort.MINIMAL, Effort.LOW]
            and item.priority in [Priority.CRITICAL, Priority.HIGH]
            and item.status != Status.COMPLETED
        ]
    
    def get_progress_summary(self) -> Dict:
        """Get progress summary by category."""
        summary = {
            'total': len(self.items),
            'completed': sum(1 for i in self.items if i.status == Status.COMPLETED),
            'in_progress': sum(1 for i in self.items if i.status == Status.IN_PROGRESS),
            'by_category': {},
            'by_priority': {}
        }
        
        for item in self.items:
            if item.category not in summary['by_category']:
                summary['by_category'][item.category] = {'total': 0, 'completed': 0}
            summary['by_category'][item.category]['total'] += 1
            if item.status == Status.COMPLETED:
                summary['by_category'][item.category]['completed'] += 1
        
        return summary

        # By Category

            if item.category != current_category:

                current_category = item.category
            
            status_icon = {
                Status.COMPLETED: "✅",
                Status.IN_PROGRESS: "🔄",
                Status.BLOCKED: "🚫",
                Status.NOT_STARTED: "⬜"

            }[item.priority]
            
            lines.append(
                f"- {status_icon} {priority_label} **{item.id}**: {item.title}"
            )
            lines.append(f"  - {item.description}")
        
        return "\n".join(lines)
```

|--------|------------------|---------------------|-------|
| Uptime SLA | High | Medium | Push for 99.9%+ |
| Liability Cap | High | Low-Medium | Seek super caps |
| Data Ownership | Critical | Medium | Non-negotiable |
| Security Standards | High | High | Usually agreed |

## Quick Reference: Red Flags to Watch

⚠️ **Scope Creep Risks**
- Vague service descriptions
- Unlimited modification rights
- No change notice requirements

⚠️ **SLA Weaknesses**
- No uptime commitment
- Excessive exclusions
- Credits as sole remedy for everything

⚠️ **Data Concerns**
- Provider ownership of derived data
- Broad aggregation/anonymization rights
- Unclear deletion commitments
- No data portability

⚠️ **Liability Issues**
- Very low caps (3-6 months fees)
- No super caps for data breach
- One-sided limitations

⚠️ **Termination Traps**
- No termination for convenience
- Auto-renewal with long notice periods
- Early termination penalties
- No transition assistance

```yaml
# .github/branch-protection.yml (example for GitHub)
branches:
  main:
    protection:
      required_pull_request_reviews:
        required_approving_review_count: 2
        dismiss_stale_reviews: true
        require_code_owner_reviews: true
        require_last_push_approval: true
      required_status_checks:
        strict: true
        contexts:
          - "ci/build"
          - "ci/test"
          - "ci/security-scan"
          - "ci/lint"
      required_linear_history: true
      required_signatures: true
      enforce_admins: true
      restrictions:
        users: []
        teams:
          - "release-managers"
      allow_force_pushes: false
      allow_deletions: false
  
  "release/*":
    protection:
      required_pull_request_reviews:
        required_approving_review_count: 1
      required_status_checks:
        strict: true
        contexts:
          - "ci/build"
          - "ci/test"
      restrictions:
        teams:
          - "release-managers"
```

## 3. Build & Test Stages

### Complete GitHub Actions Pipeline

```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml
name: Complete CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop, 'release/*', 'feature/*']
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Nightly security scans
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Target environment'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - development
          - staging
          - production
      skip_tests:
        description: 'Skip test execution'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
  GO_VERSION: '1.21'
  NODE_VERSION: '20'

# Cancel in-progress runs for same branch
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 1: Code Quality & Linting
  # ============================================================================
  lint:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Full history for better analysis

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v4
        with:
          version: latest
          args: --timeout=5m --config=.golangci.yml
          
      - name: Check Go formatting
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(gofmt -l .)" ]; then
            echo "Go code is not formatted:"
            gofmt -d .
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Check for vulnerabilities
        run: |
          go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest
          govulncheck ./...

      - name: Lint Dockerfiles
        uses: hadolint/hadolint-action@v3.1.0
        with:
          dockerfile: Dockerfile
          failure-threshold: warning

      - name: Lint Kubernetes manifests
        uses: stackrox/kube-linter-action@v1
        with:
          directory: deploy/k8s

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 2: Build Application
  # ============================================================================
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [lint]
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.version.outputs.sha_short }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Generate version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
            VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/heads/main ]]; then
            VERSION="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//' || echo '0.0.0')-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
          else
            VERSION="0.0.0-dev-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "sha_short=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Generated version: $VERSION"

      - name: Download dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go mod verify

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build \
            -ldflags="-s -w \
              -X main.Version=${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} \
              -X main.GitCommit=${{ github.sha }} \
              -X main.BuildTime=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
            -o bin/app ./cmd/server

      - name: Build additional architectures
        run: |
          for arch in arm64; do
            CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=$arch go build \
              -ldflags="-s -w" \
              -o bin/app-linux-$arch ./cmd/server
          done

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: binaries
          path: bin/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 3: Unit Tests
  # ============================================================================
  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [build]
    if: ${{ !inputs.skip_tests }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          go test -v -race -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic \
            -timeout=10m ./...

      - name: Generate coverage report
        run: |
          go tool cover -html=coverage.out -o coverage.html
          go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: ./coverage.out
          flags: unittests
          fail_ci_if_error: true

      - name: Check coverage threshold
        run: |
          COVERAGE=$(go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1 | awk '{print $3}' | sed 's/%//')
          THRESHOLD=80
          if (( $(echo "$COVERAGE < $THRESHOLD" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Coverage $COVERAGE% is below threshold $THRESHOLD%"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Coverage $COVERAGE% meets threshold $THRESHOLD%"

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: |
            coverage.out
            coverage.html

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 4: Integration Tests
  # ============================================================================
  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    needs: [build]
    if: ${{ !inputs.skip_tests && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release/')) }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Wait for services
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
          until pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U test; do sleep 1; done
          echo "Waiting for Redis..."
          until redis-cli -h localhost -p 6379 ping; do sleep 1; done

      - name: Run database migrations
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://test:test@localhost:5432/testdb?sslmode=disable
        run: |
          go install github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/v4/cmd/migrate@latest
          migrate -path ./migrations -database "$DATABASE_URL" up

      - name: Run integration tests
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://test:test@localhost:5432/testdb?sslmode=disable
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379
          TEST_INTEGRATION: true
        run: |
          go test -v -tags=integration -timeout=20m \
            -coverprofile=integration-coverage.out ./tests/integration/...

      - name: Upload integration test coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: ./integration-coverage.out
          flags: integration

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 5: Security Scanning
  # ============================================================================
  security-scan:
    name: Security Scanning
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [build]
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner (filesystem)
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          scan-ref: '.'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-fs-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

      - name: Run Gosec Security Scanner
        uses: securego/gosec@master
        with:
          args: '-no-fail -fmt sarif -out gosec-results.sarif ./...'

      - name: Run Semgrep
        uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: >-
            p/golang
            p/secrets
            p/security-audit
          generateSarif: true

      - name: Upload SARIF results to GitHub Security
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: trivy-fs-results.sarif

      - name: Check for critical vulnerabilities
        run: |
          if grep -q '"severity": "CRITICAL"' trivy-fs-results.sarif 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "Critical vulnerabilities found!"
            exit 1
          fi

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 6: Build & Push Container Image
  # ============================================================================
  build-image:
    name: Build Container Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [unit-tests, integration-tests, security-scan]
    if: always() && !failure() && !cancelled()
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      id-token: write  # For signing
    outputs:
      image: ${{ steps.build.outputs.imageid }}
      digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

      - name: Build and push
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}
            GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }}
            BUILD_TIME=${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}
          provenance: true
          sbom: true

      - name: Install Cosign
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3

      - name: Sign container image
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL: "true"
        run: |
          cosign sign --yes ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}

      - name: Scan container image
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-image-results.sarif'

      - name: Upload container scan results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: trivy-image-results.sarif

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 7: Deploy to Development
  # ============================================================================
  deploy-dev:
    name: Deploy to Development
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [build-image]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    environment:
      name: development
      url: https://dev.example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
        with:
          version: 'v1.28.0'

      - name: Configure kubeconfig
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.kube
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_DEV }}" | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config

      - name: Deploy with Kustomize
        run: |
          cd deploy/k8s/overlays/development
          kustomize edit set image app=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
          kustomize build . | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Wait for rollout
        run: |
          kubectl rollout status deployment/app -n development --timeout=300s

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          ./scripts/smoke-test.sh https://dev.example.com

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 8: Deploy to Staging
  # ============================================================================
  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [build-image, deploy-dev]
    if: |
      always() && 
      (needs.deploy-dev.result == 'success' || needs.deploy-dev.result == 'skipped') &&
      needs.build-image.result == 'success' &&
      (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release/'))
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v3
        with:
          version: '3.13.0'

      - name: Configure kubeconfig
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.kube
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_STAGING }}" | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config

      - name: Deploy with Helm (Blue-Green)
        run: |
          # Determine active color
          ACTIVE_COLOR=$(kubectl get svc app-active -n staging -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.color}' 2>/dev/null || echo "blue")
          DEPLOY_COLOR=$([[ "$ACTIVE_COLOR" == "blue" ]] && echo "green" || echo "blue")
          
          echo "Active: $ACTIVE_COLOR, Deploying to: $DEPLOY_COLOR"
          
          # Deploy to inactive color
          helm upgrade --install app-$DEPLOY_COLOR ./deploy/helm/app \
            --namespace staging \
            --set image.repository=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }} \
            --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }} \
            --set color=$DEPLOY_COLOR \
            --set replicaCount=3 \
            --values ./deploy/helm/app/values-staging.yaml \
            --wait --timeout=5m
          
          # Run tests against new deployment
          kubectl run smoke-test --rm -i --restart=Never \
            --image=curlimages/curl:latest \
            --namespace=staging \
            -- curl -sf http://app-$DEPLOY_COLOR:8080/health

      - name: Switch traffic (Blue-Green)
        run: |
          ACTIVE_COLOR=$(kubectl get svc app-active -n staging -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.color}' 2>/dev/null || echo "blue")
          NEW_COLOR=$([[ "$ACTIVE_COLOR" == "blue" ]] && echo "green" || echo "blue")
          
          # Switch service selector
          kubectl patch svc app-active -n staging \
            -p "{\"spec\":{\"selector\":{\"color\":\"$NEW_COLOR\"}}}"
          
          echo "Traffic switched to $NEW_COLOR"

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm ci
          npm run test:staging

      - name: Scale down old deployment
        if: success()
        run: |
          ACTIVE_COLOR=$(kubectl get svc app-active -n staging -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.color}')
          OLD_COLOR=$([[ "$ACTIVE_COLOR" == "blue" ]] && echo "green" || echo "blue")
          kubectl scale deployment app-$OLD_COLOR -n staging --replicas=0

  # ============================================================================
  # STAGE 9: Deploy to Production (Canary)
  # ============================================================================
  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    needs: [deploy-staging]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://app.example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure kubeconfig
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.kube
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_PROD }}" | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config

      - name: Install Argo Rollouts
        run: |
          kubectl apply -n argo-rollouts -f https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/releases/latest/download/install.yaml

      - name: Deploy Canary
        run: |
          # Update rollout with new image
          kubectl argo rollouts set image app-rollout \
            app=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n production

      - name: Monitor Canary (5% traffic)
        run: |
          echo "Canary at 5% traffic, monitoring for 5 minutes..."
          sleep 300
          
          # Check metrics
          ERROR_RATE=$(curl -s "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(http_requests_total{status=~'5..'}[5m])/rate(http_requests_total[5m])" | jq '.data.result[0].value[1]' -r)
          
          if (( $(echo "$ERROR_RATE > 0.01" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Error rate too high: $ERROR_RATE"
            kubectl argo rollouts abort app-rollout -n production
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Promote Canary (25% traffic)
        run: |
          kubectl argo rollouts promote app-rollout -n production
          echo "Canary at 25% traffic, monitoring for 5 minutes..."
          sleep 300

      - name: Promote Canary (50% traffic)
        run: |
          kubectl argo rollouts promote app-rollout -n production
          echo "Canary at 50% traffic, monitoring for 5 minutes..."
          sleep 300

      - name: Full Promotion (100% traffic)
        run: |
          kubectl argo rollouts promote app-rollout -n production --full
          kubectl argo rollouts status app-rollout -n production --timeout=300s

      - name: Notify deployment success
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "✅ Deployment to production successful",
              "blocks": [
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": "*Deployment Successful*\n• Version: ${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}\n• Commit: ${{ github.sha }}\n• Environment: Production"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}

  # ============================================================================
  # ROLLBACK JOB (Manual Trigger)
  # ============================================================================
  rollback:
    name: Rollback Deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && failure()
    needs: [deploy-production]
    environment:
      name: production
    steps:
      - name: Configure kubeconfig
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.kube
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_PROD }}" | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config

      - name: Rollback using Argo Rollouts
        run: |
          kubectl argo rollouts undo app-rollout -n production
          kubectl argo rollouts status app-rollout -n production --timeout=300s

      - name: Notify rollback
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "⚠️ Production rollback executed",
              "blocks": [
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": "*Rollback Executed*\n• Environment: Production\n• Triggered by: ${{ github.actor }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
```

### Dockerfile (Multi-stage Build)

```dockerfile
# Dockerfile
# =============================================================================
# BUILD STAGE
# =============================================================================
FROM golang:1.21-alpine AS builder

# Install build dependencies
RUN apk add --no-cache git ca-certificates tzdata

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy dependency files first (better caching)
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download && go mod verify

# Copy source code
COPY . .

# Build arguments for versioning
ARG VERSION=dev
ARG GIT_COMMIT=unknown
ARG BUILD_TIME=unknown

# Build the application
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build \
    -ldflags="-s -w \
        -X main.Version=${VERSION} \
        -X main.GitCommit=${GIT_COMMIT} \
        -X main.BuildTime=${BUILD_TIME}" \
    -o /app/server ./cmd/server

# =============================================================================
# SECURITY SCAN STAGE
# =============================================================================
FROM aquasec/trivy:latest AS scanner

COPY --from=builder /app/server /app/server

RUN trivy filesystem --no-progress --severity HIGH,CRITICAL \
    --exit-code 1 /app/server

# =============================================================================
# RUNTIME STAGE
# =============================================================================
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot AS runtime

# Labels for container metadata
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/org/repo"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="Application server"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses="MIT"

# Copy timezone data and CA certificates
COPY --from=builder /usr/share/zoneinfo /usr/share/zoneinfo
COPY --from=builder /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/

# Copy binary from builder
COPY --from=builder /app/server /server

# Use nonroot user
USER nonroot:nonroot

# Expose port
EXPOSE 8080

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD ["/server", "health"]

# Run server
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
CMD ["serve"]
```
